jobs.title: AI Evaluation Engineer (Python, QA or Security)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Rockstar is recruiting for a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making autism and ADHD care more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. Through a modern, tech-enabled care model, they help patients navigate evaluations and therapy with greater clarity, communication, and support. They are a small, highly collaborative team that values ownership, responsiveness, operational clarity, and calm execution under pressure.

About the Role

They are looking for a highly organized, empathetic, and resourceful Care Concierge / Patient Intake Coordinator to serve as the primary point of contact for patients and families throughout their care journey. The aim is to ensure patients receive the level of service and compassion one would want for their loved ones.

This role combines customer support, scheduling, coordination, patient communication, clinician coordination, administrative follow-through, and operational problem-solving.

They will help families:

  • Schedule evaluations
  • Complete required paperwork
  • Navigate insurance and intake requirements
  • Understand next steps
  • Stay informed throughout the process

Many of the families spoken with may already feel overwhelmed, confused, or frustrated before reaching the company. The ability to communicate clearly, stay organized, and calmly guide conversations forward will play a major role in the overall patient experience.

This is not a passive call center role. They are looking for someone who can think critically, follow structured workflows carefully, manage multiple moving parts at once, and operate independently in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

The role serves as the primary point of contact for the company's patients and families via phone, email, and live chat:

  • Schedule and coordinate diagnostic evaluations
  • Collect and verify intake information, insurance details, and required documentation
  • Follow up with patients regarding missing forms or appointment requirements
  • Respond professionally and empathetically to patient questions and concerns
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within internal systems
  • Coordinate with operations and clinical teams to resolve scheduling or workflow issues
  • Research and provide post-diagnosis support resources when needed
  • Help identify recurring operational issues and suggest workflow improvements

What They're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-volume or emotionally sensitive situations
  • Comfortable managing multiple conversations and tasks simultaneously
  • Reliable remote work setup with high-speed internet
  • Backup power and backup internet solution available during outages
  • Ability to work primarily during US business hours
  • Comfortable working independently within a structured remote workflow

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous healthcare support, patient coordination, or customer service experience
  • Experience working remotely in fast-paced environments
  • Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Zendesk, Intercom, or EHR systems
  • Basic understanding of healthcare or insurance terminology

What They Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Competitive monthly compensation
  • A supportive and collaborative startup team
  • Opportunity to help shape and improve patient experience operations
  • Meaningful work supporting families through important healthcare decisions
  • High-autonomy environment focused on results, communication, and accountability
  • Zero micromanagement

Application Process

All applicants will complete:

  1. A short application questionnaire
  2. A brief video interview with the recruitment team
  3. A final interview with the hiring manager
  4. If all goes well, an offer of employment

They review applications carefully and prioritize candidates who demonstrate strong communication, professionalism, operational thinking, and attention to detail. They look forward to hearing from applicants.

The company is committed to building an inclusive and supportive remote work environment for talented professionals globally.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.

  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with the wider NBA platform stack, including React/TypeScript, Java services, and Decision Intelligence systems.
  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling, auditability, and compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB

This position develops and maintains collaboration among local agencies, community stakeholders, advocacy groups and political units, such as County Managers and Boards of Commissioners. The position serves as a collaborative partner in identifying system barriers, developing solutions, and leading related efforts in the assigned communities. This position works with other Vaya departments to address identified needs within the region.

Note: This position requires access to and use of confidential healthcare information or protected health information (PHI) as described in laws addressing patient confidentiality, including, but not limited to, the federal HIPAA law, the Confidentiality of Alcohol and Substance Abuse Patient Records law, 42 CFR Part 2, and various state laws. As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Health. The individual filling this position shall also sign a confidentiality statement as an employee of Vaya Health.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Community Relations:

Represents Vaya and fulfills the MCO’s role in meeting community stakeholder needs by serving on related community boards and agency committees. Examples include, but are not limited to, regular meetings with Health Department, DSS, school system, DJJ, law enforcement leadership personnel, County Managers, County Boards of Commissioners, and other designated Vaya stakeholder groups or individuals. Responds to inquiries and concerns from agencies and stakeholders by resolving the issues or identifying other Vaya departments to assist. Educates and informs community agencies and boards about MCO functions, resources, and provider capacity. Strives to address barriers that prevent members or other stakeholders from achieving full participation in their communities; offers related recommendations to MCO Management Team for direction when items of concern are identified and require resolution. Independently identifies and intervenes to offer solutions to issues between local stakeholders and the MCO.

Training and Support of Staff:

The Community Relations Regional Director empowers Vaya members and their communities to identify needs, employ community resources (as feasible), and generate local solutions to help bridge healthcare gaps. In developing each community’s capacity to address existing health disparities team members foster collaborative relations and promote effective partnerships among stakeholders. Such partnerships among stakeholders. Such partnerships support community engagement and serve as the foundation for developing community-driven approaches to addressing healthcare needs.

Vaya Health Leadership Member:

Participates as a member of Vaya’s Leadership in making decisions and providing leadership to the agency. Represents the needs and issues of their assigned counties (4 to 7 counties) to Vaya Leadership, and keeps the team informed of issues for the region. This position represents Vaya Health in many venues in their assigned region such as County Board of Commissioners, local providers, and agencies. This person also provides regional input into the UM State Plan for their region and any initiatives or projects in the region.

Other duties as assigned by the Community Relations Vice President.

A high level of diplomacy and discretion is required to effectively negotiate and resolve issues. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills are essential. Demonstrate effective leadership presence required, with demonstrated confidence in dealing with unknown and complex issues. Awareness of and sensitivity to local political issues.

In the Community Relations Regional Director role, the employee must have knowledge of mental health, developmental disabilities and substance abuse services systems and evidence-based practices and programs. The employee must have a willingness to become proficient in all disability areas, including areas where co-occurring illnesses exist. jobs.excerpt: EventMobi is a remote-first company, and this is a fully remote position.
jobs.description:
EventMobi is a remote-first company, and this is a fully remote position. This role is open to candidates based anywhere in Canada, but requires flexibility in working hours to align with ET and ensure overlap with the global marketing team.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

Own the engine. Content, SEO/AEO, campaigns, product launches: the stuff that actually moves EventMobi's pipeline forward, not just sits on a slide.

Here's the best part: you'll be marketing a product tens of thousands of event marketers genuinely love. EventMobi's bootstrapped, founded in 2010, and growing fast in the age of AI. No VC runway clock, no growth-at-all-costs nonsense. The best conference planners in North America and Europe run their events on us. That's the product you get to tell the story of.

This is a player/coach role. You'll lead the content team and you won't do it alone: demand gen, marketing ops, events, product, and sales all show up to help you ship work you're proud of.

WHO YOU ARE

You write. You edit. You know good messaging when you see it, and you know how to fix it when it isn’t. Email, web, video, blog: no matter the format, you turn it into campaigns that perform across channels.

You're smart enough to learn the language our buyers speak and how our products actually work, straight from Sales and Product.

You're the person who keeps 12 things moving at once without dropping one. Deadlines don't slip on your watch. The marketing calendar is a living, breathing thing you control, not a spreadsheet that controls you.

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON

1. Organic Demand is Your Jam

You own the content gap analysis. You know exactly what's missing across every funnel, TOFU to BOFU, and you go build it. Blog, landing pages, website videos, YouTube scripts, lead magnets: you create it and update it, with your creative and marketing admin backing you up to keep execution on fire.

SEO and AEO strategy is yours end to end. Keyword tracking, prompt tracking, and you set the priorities based on what'll actually move the needle. You don't let content die after one publish. Repurposing content in different formats is in your blood. You know how to build effective campaigns for distribution.

And the social program, company/founder/SME are yours to lead. You own the calendar and call the shots on what gets promoted. You don’t wait around for direction.

2. You Create Product Launches and Campaigns That Move the Pipeline

You own the campaign strategy, calendar and content. Work back schedules, status updates, across new-business, customer campaigns, every email that goes out the door.

You're the last line of defence before anything ships. Emails, launch videos, customer comms: if it's off-brand, off-message, or just not good enough, it doesn't go out until you say so.

You partner with the Product Team to make sure launches aren't just on time; they're built to actually generate pipeline. And you keep regional marketing in lockstep so launches land together, not as disconnected efforts.

SUPPORT & COLLABORATION

You've got a global team behind you. Here's who's in it with you:

  • Marketing Admin & Creative: reports to you. Your right hand on video, blog, social and lead magnet production.
  • VP of Marketing: direction setting, prioritization, and the person who clears cross-functional blockers when you hit them.
  • Marketing Operations: the backend muscle. Systems, analytics, and execution support for website and platform decisions.
  • Product Team: positioning, feature messaging, and launch readiness, so you're never guessing what the product actually does.
  • Regional Marketing: your partner across Germany, UK and rest of Europe, keeping campaigns and launches in sync instead of running in parallel.
  • Sales Leadership: the sounding board for what is priority for prospects and customers. And content that can help close deals at the bottom of the funnel.
  • Tools: We will arm you with the fanciest tools and hardware to win the battle: Gong, AirOps, Claude, Zapier, HubSpot, WordPress, Notion, Fellow, Slack, Google Workspace… the mighty MacBook, and humble Pen & Paper.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience. Corporate side, not agency.
  • You've built and run an SEO/AEO strategy yourself, from scratch. Not just executed inside someone else's plan.
  • You've owned a content and campaign calendar end to end, and lived to tell about it.
  • You write and edit at a high level. You know what's good, what's not, and how to fix it, and you can turn brand voice and positioning into copy that actually lands.
  • You've coordinated product launches across product and regional teams and know how many moving pieces that takes.
  • You use AI in your daily workflow and pick up new tools fast.
  • You're comfortable with high autonomy. You take work off a VP's plate without needing the role spelled out for you first.

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Compensation: CA$120,000-$150,000 (Base + Bonus), Stock Option, and Benefits
  • Time-Off: 15 days annual leave + 3 summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun)
  • Regional in-person gatherings and co-working sessions to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Tools: Top-of-the-line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work, so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone who has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30 Mbps download speed

ABOUT EVENTMOBI

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 40,000 events in 70+ countries, from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, American Political Science Association, GE, Best Buy, Ontario Nursing Association have all trusted EventMobi's suite of software to manage their internal and public conferences and engage their attendees, speakers and sponsors.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

APPLICATION NOTE: We'd love to hear from you. Successful applicants will receive a link to an on-demand video interview.

As part of your application, you will be asked to describe a content strategy, SEO/AEO initiative, or campaign you built and owned end to end — including the goal, the channels and formats involved, and the results it drove. This helps us understand your marketing background.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Salary: CA$120,000-$150,000 (Base + Bonus)

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Become a Part of Our Caring Community

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Lead Product Manager to drive product management initiatives across IT Infrastructure, with a specific focus on Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure Cloud capabilities, infrastructure modernization, cloud onboarding and migrations, platform reliability, automation, security alignment, and technology lifecycle management.

This role is responsible for conceiving, developing, delivering, and managing cloud infrastructure products and capabilities used across Humana. The Lead Product Manager - Technical oversees all phases of the product lifecycle, from design conception through delivery, adoption, optimization, ongoing support, and lifecycle management. This role works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial and requires the ability to translate complex cloud, infrastructure, security, operational, and business needs into scalable, secure, compliant, and business-aligned technology solutions.

The ideal candidate is a strong cross-functional leader who partners closely with cloud engineering, Google Cloud platform teams, Azure platform teams, infrastructure engineering, network, compute, storage, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, operations, ServiceNow, Application Portfolio Management, Technology Lifecycle Management, governance, compliance, application teams, and vendor partners.

This role will help ensure cloud infrastructure products remain current, reliable, secure, cost-conscious, supportable, observable, and aligned to Humana Technology standards. The role is expected to bring product discipline, structure, influence, and technical fluency to advance cloud modernization, reduce technical debt, improve platform adoption, and deliver measurable business value through Google Cloud and Azure Cloud capabilities.

Role is work-from-home and aligned to one of the following IT Hub cities: Louisville, Dallas/Frisco, Washington/Arlington Metro, Nashville, Fort Lauderdale or Tampa, and Atlanta.

The Lead Product Manager advises leaders and stakeholders on matters of significance and helps develop functional strategies related to cloud infrastructure products, cloud onboarding, platform lifecycle, modernization, technical debt remediation, automation, operational readiness, and governance.

This role exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues related to product strategy, cloud delivery, platform dependencies, governance requirements, security controls, risks, dependencies, and related tasks. In addition, this role provides leadership, training, and support to Delivery Leads and Cloud Engineers who provision cloud, database, and network security infrastructure provisioning across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Lifecycle Management

  • Establish and lead the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for legacy cloud migrations, new cloud infrastructure provisioning, and associated IT infrastructure capabilities.
  • Manage infrastructure product capabilities across cloud onboarding, cloud landing zones, tenant enablement, identity and access patterns, compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, automation, monitoring, observability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, and platform lifecycle management.
  • Oversee and manage all phases of the cloud infrastructure product lifecycle, from concept and discovery through design, build, delivery, implementation, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
  • Translate infrastructure, engineering, operational, security, architecture, and governance needs into clear product capabilities, deliverables, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize initiatives across Google Cloud, Azure Cloud, cloud platform services, infrastructure automation, ServiceNow workflows, lifecycle governance, technical debt remediation, and modernization programs to maximize business value and reduce enterprise risk.
  • Ensure product roadmaps align with Humana Technology standards, enterprise architecture direction, cybersecurity requirements, compliance expectations, operational support models, and business objectives.

Cloud Onboarding, Tenant Enablement, and Platform Adoption

  • Lead and improve on existing End-to-End cloud onboarding and migration processes for application and business technology teams adopting Google Cloud and Azure Cloud services.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure application teams complete required infrastructure onboarding activities, including provisioning requirements, architecture documentation and approvals, deployment planning, resiliency and disaster recovery requirements, and access considerations.
  • Support planning for cloud onboarding activities, including cloud intake, application-specific distribution lists, access groups, resource build sheets, resource limit requirements, architecture review, security review, tenant provisioning, resource access, database intake, and network security requests.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architecture, platform engineering, security, and governance teams to ensure cloud onboarding follows approved design patterns and technology standards.
  • Promote adoption of approved cloud design patterns, reference architectures, reusable onboarding processes, and standardized deployment practices.
  • Help identify/escalate/resolve onboarding friction points across Google Cloud and Azure Cloud, including access delays, environment readiness, CI/CD readiness, network connectivity, security review dependencies, and operational handoff gaps.

Infrastructure Modernization and Platform Reliability

  • Partner with infrastructure engineering and cloud operations teams to design, build, implement, and support modern cloud infrastructure products and platforms.
  • Support modernization efforts involving Google Cloud, Azure Cloud, virtual machines, managed compute, containers, Kubernetes, storage, networking, application hosting, observability, automation, and resilient architecture patterns.
  • Translate infrastructure needs into product requirements, including capacity planning, environment readiness, access management, deployment dependencies, monitoring, alerting, disaster recovery, resilience, and service availability.
  • Drive improvements in platform reliability, scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and operational sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, reduce manual effort, improve standardization, and accelerate delivery of cloud infrastructure services.
  • Support cost-conscious cloud practices, including resource usage monitoring, tagging, cost allocation, rightsizing, lifecycle management, and reduction of unsupported or underutilized cloud assets.

Stakeholder Communication and Change Management

  • Lead cross-functional communication to ensure alignment on cloud infrastructure priorities, timelines, scope, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
  • Support change management efforts, including stakeholder readiness, training, documentation, adoption strategies, release communications, and operational transition planning.
  • Act as an advocate for cloud consumers, infrastructure users, engineering teams, operations teams, application owners, governance stakeholders, and enterprise technology partners.
  • Advise stakeholders and leadership on product trade-offs, delivery risks, technical constraints, lifecycle exposure, cloud platform dependencies, infrastructure dependencies, and recommended courses of action.
  • Communicate outcomes, risks, trade-offs, value realization, and roadmap progress to senior leaders and stakeholders.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8 or more years of technical, product management, infrastructure, IT delivery, cloud technology, technology operations, or related experience.
  • 3 or more years specifically related to cloud infrastructure migration product and program management
  • 2 or more years of project, program, product, or cross-functional leadership experience.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including cloud engineering, Google Cloud teams, Azure Cloud teams, infrastructure engineering, network, compute, storage, operations, architecture, cybersecurity, compliance, governance, analytics, and vendor partners.
  • Proven ability to translate complex cloud, infrastructure, operational, governance, and technical needs into scalable technology solutions and prioritized product deliverables.
  • Experience creating, prioritizing, and managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans.
  • Experience applying Agile frameworks to deliver large-scale technology products in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, monitoring, logging, automation, disaster recovery, and platform reliability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues with minimal supervision.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders, align teams, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Candidate should bring either:
    • Strong subject matter expertise in Google Cloud, Azure Cloud, IT Infrastructure, technology lifecycle management, technical debt remediation, cloud operations, and enterprise technology governance; or
    • Strong product management expertise, technical fluency, and a product mindset for delivery of complex enterprise cloud infrastructure products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cloud infrastructure product management, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure Cloud, infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, platform engineering, or technology operations.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud modernization and onboarding processes, including cloud design patterns, resource build sheets, tenant provisioning, access requests, architecture review, security review, and deployment readiness.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud capabilities such as projects, folders, organizations, IAM, VPC networking, compute, storage, Kubernetes, logging, monitoring, and cloud-native platform services.
  • Familiarity with Azure capabilities such as subscriptions, resource groups, Azure Kubernetes Service, virtual networks, managed identities, Azure Policy, compute, storage, monitoring, and cloud-native platform services.
  • Experience with Technology Lifecycle Management, end-of-life remediation, technical debt governance, application portfolio management, configuration management, ServiceNow, and decommissioning processes.
  • Experience with infrastructure modernization, cloud-enabled platforms, automation, application hosting, disaster recovery, platform reliability, operational resilience, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Experience demonstrating business impact, operational value, risk reduction, compliance improvement, and return on investment for technology product initiatives.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity, technology standards, audit requirements, infrastructure governance, cloud governance, and enterprise risk management.
  • Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework or Agile Release Train structure.
  • MBA, advanced degree, or relevant product, Agile, Google Cloud, Azure, infrastructure, ITIL, ServiceNow, or technology certification

This role requires the ability to manage products that involve Google Cloud, Azure Cloud, infrastructure capabilities, platform services, lifecycle governance, technical debt remediation, automation, cloud onboarding, and technology operations. The Lead Product Manager is expected to understand product delivery, cloud infrastructure dependencies, Agile execution, operational impacts, technology standards, governance requirements, security considerations, platform reliability, and value realization across complex enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Unitary is a rapidly growing startup on a mission to transform how businesses get work done.
jobs.description:
Unitary is a rapidly growing startup on a mission to transform how businesses get work done.

We build Virtual Agents, AI-powered software workers that automate complex back-office operations. Virtual Agents are a proprietary blend of AI models and deterministic systems, built agentically. They combine advanced reasoning with human-in-the-loop oversight in a system designed to deliver reliable, production-grade automation with guaranteed outcomes.

We are expanding rapidly across insurance, marketplaces, and healthcare, in industries where operational complexity, legacy systems, and cost pressure make traditional automation approaches too risky or too slow.

Backed by Plural and Creandum, we raised a $15M Series A in 2024 and are building a new category of outcome-guaranteed automation for complex operations. This is an opportunity to join at a pivotal stage and help shape how businesses adopt AI safely and at scale.

The role

We are looking for a Support Engineer to help formalise and grow our support function. ​​This is a hands-on, operationally focused role that will be based in our Service Operations Engineering team.

Your mission will be to keep our live customer Virtual Agents running smoothly and to help build the processes and tooling to make that easier over time. You will be the first responder for technical issues: triaging problems, coordinating with the right people, and implementing the resolution. You will maintain and update customer workflows, ensure our platform remains secure and healthy, and operate the AI decision engine that drives improvements to our overall system accuracy.

When things are quieter on the operations front, you will contribute to the engineering work that makes the whole team more effective. This will include improving internal tooling, writing runbooks, and helping build self-service capabilities so our internal agent operations teams can resolve more issues independently.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Work closely with our operations engineering lead and customer success team to establish priorities across multiple customers and ensure operational excellence.
  • Triage and resolve technical issues raised by customers and internal teams.
  • Lead or contribute to post-mortems when contractual service level agreement breaches occur, identifying root causes and driving preventive improvements.
  • Operate the AI decision engine to make targeted improvements to automation accuracy.
  • Update customer workflows when requirements change, working with the customer success team to assess scope and confirm delivery timelines with the customer.
  • Contribute to internal tooling and automation that will drive efficiency during the day-to-day service operations.
  • Write and maintain runbooks and documentation that enable our internal agent operations teams to become more self-sufficient over time.
  • Participate in our 24/7 on-call rotation.

Requirements

You

We are looking for someone who is excited about building innovative solutions and wants to have a large impact in a smaller company; you will be a key part of defining Unitary’s future during this early stage of our next growth journey. We need versatile people who are happy to get stuck into whatever needs doing, and are ready to learn and grow with the company.

For this particular role, we need a collaborative and operationally minded engineer who stays calm under pressure and takes ownership of problems from start to finish. You will balance reactive work (responding to issues and supporting customers) with proactive improvements to the systems and processes around you. Communication is crucial as you will work closely with colleagues across multiple teams and disciplines, often coordinating during time-sensitive situations.

We would love to hear from you if you:

  • Have experience supporting live production systems, including debugging and troubleshooting issues across the stack
  • Can demonstrate a proactive and autonomous approach to problem solving
  • Are confident writing production code in Python
  • Communicate clearly, both in written documentation and when coordinating with technical and non-technical colleagues in time-sensitive situations
  • Have experience with incident triage and response, and post-mortem processes

It would be even better, but not essential, if you have:

  • Previous experience working in a startup or small team
  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems (e.g. Temporal)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana or Prometheus
  • Familiarity with ML/AI systems at an operational level; you do not need to build models, but understanding how they fit into a production system is helpful
  • Experience writing runbooks, internal documentation, or building self-service tooling for non-engineering users.

Benefits

About us

The team

Unitary is a remote-first team of 25+ people spread across Europe and North America who are fiercely passionate about making the internet a better place, and deeply motivated to become a force for good. We have an ambition to create a company filled with happy, kind and collaborative people who achieve extraordinary things together. Our culture is built around the power of trust, transparency and self-leadership.

Working at Unitary

We are committed to creating a positive and inclusive culture built on genuine interest for each other's well-being. We offer progressive and market-leading benefits, including:

  • Flexible hours and location
  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Occupational pension
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Generous paid sick leave
  • Annual budget for your professional development and growth
  • Annual budget for your individual health and wellness
  • Three team offsites to London or other exciting destinations in Europe

As the role requires joining a 24/7 on-call support rotation, there will be additional compensation for these shifts.

Location: Brazil

Technical Support Engineer – BIC - iTwin Support Engineer

A Technical Support Engineer in the BIC - iTwin space provides expert technical guidance across Bentley products, with a focus on iTwin, iModels, Design Review, CAD synchronisation, cloud-based workflows, and enterprise support scenarios. The role works directly with users and global Bentley teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, reproduce, document, and resolve complex technical issues in real-world customer environments. The engineer demonstrates independent judgement, user empathy, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate clear technical findings while meeting team goals and continuously developing product expertise.

Responsibilities

• Care about users and focus on making sure Bentley products can support their success in the BIC - iTwin space.

• Act as a main technical support contact for users, resolving technical support requests via phone, e-mail, web portals, and Bentley Communities.

• Perform advanced software troubleshooting, including installation, configuration, product functionality, iModel workflows, and cloud-based support scenarios.

• Engage with users to gather detailed information, collect logs for investigation, and ask targeted questions to narrow down the root cause.

• Diagnose and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues across Windows, enterprise networks, and on-premises/cloud environments.

• Validate protocols and symptoms such as HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, timeouts, certificate errors, DNS, firewalls, security groups, and proxies; gather evidence and produce clear findings.

• Interpret application, system, and network logs to identify root causes and document the technical findings clearly.

• Reproduce issues in test environments, including simulation of network topologies, application configurations, and iTwin/iModel workflows where appropriate.

• Serve as the primary support liaison between Bentley Systems and users for urgent or complex technical issues.

• Properly escalate issues requiring developers, product managers, quality assurance, or other internal teams, including product defects, enhancement requests, and systemic case trends.

• Maintain accurate and timely notes on user support cases, provide documentation to users, and contribute technical knowledge to internal repositories and Bentley Communities.

• Share updates on issues that could affect multiple users or accounts and assist Product & Technology teams in prioritising improvements and fixes based on user impact.

• Continuously upskill on product updates, iTwin/iModel workflows, enterprise networking concepts, cloud technologies, and troubleshooting techniques.

• Work on career goals and personal development skills to become a more effective and valuable colleague.

Communication & Collaboration

• Collaborate with global teams, developers, product managers, and cross-functional partners to diagnose and resolve complex issues quickly.

• Coordinate communication among team members and stakeholders, ensuring the right people are involved at the right time.

• Work with colleagues across different teams to document how Bentley products work and interact within BIC - iTwin workflows.

• Participate in daily team stand-ups and contribute to continuous improvement of processes, product understanding, and support practices.

• Communicate internally and externally with empathy, clarity, and professionalism, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms.

• Build strong relationships with users to become a trusted advisor and promote a high-quality, professional, service and adoption-oriented Bentley image.

• Share expertise internally, mentor colleagues where appropriate, and participate in community-driven support initiatives.

• Identify and suggest solutions to problems impacting the team and support consistent decision-making with key stakeholders.

• Demonstrate collaborative and leadership behaviours within team initiatives and small technical projects.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree, associate degree, higher-level degree, or equivalent experience in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Support, or a related discipline.

• 2+ years of technical support experience in SaaS, enterprise, global support, or engineering software environments; 3+ years of relevant experience preferred for advanced responsibilities.

• Experience working with users in real-world enterprise environments and exposure to global user interaction.

• Knowledge of other Bentley teams and the ability to build an expanding business network of contacts.

• Strong competence with support tools, procedures, underlying technologies, and developer collaboration needed to troubleshoot complex issues.

Technical Qualifications

• A user-first approach, strong critical thinking, and excellent troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with CAD, modelling, rendering, engineering information, or document management systems in enterprise environments.

• Product knowledge or support exposure in Design Review, iTwin, iModels, CAD synchronisation, and collaborative digital design workflows.

• Ability to create, navigate, and manage iModels to synchronise CAD files and organise project data for collaborative workflows.

• Experience with CAD software products such as MicroStation, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, and ProjectWise.

• Experience in cloud-based software support and intermediate to advanced knowledge of cloud technologies.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts, including virtual machines, databases, virtual networking, and connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.

• Support-focused networking skills, including DNS, firewalls, security groups, proxies, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, timeouts, certificate errors, and log-based evidence gathering.

• Experience with Windows Server, Windows client operating systems, Microsoft Office, and enterprise database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle.

• Familiarity with programming languages such as .NET and C++, and ability to read or interpret log files.

• Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex technical details clearly through phone, online forums, e-mail, documentation, and case notes.

• Experience in resolving technical issues, prioritising workload, managing multiple support cases, and providing timely updates and follow-through.

• Engineering background or experience with Plant Design, Building Information Management, Road Design, or modelling workflows is beneficial.

• Ability to understand the user’s environment and recommend the most effective workflow.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong desire to learn and develop expertise in BIC - iTwin technologies.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

• Ability to perform advanced troubleshooting in designated product and technical areas.

• Ability to interpret complex technical data, logs, and customer symptoms and convert them into clear findings and next steps.

• Ability to work in a global, multicultural environment and collaborate effectively across time zones and functions.

• Demonstrated collaborative skills within team activities, projects, and support initiatives.

• Strong emotional intelligence, customer empathy, and judgement when handling urgent or complex user-facing issues.

• Commitment to knowledge sharing, documentation quality, and continuous improvement of support processes.

What we offer

  • A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. 
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. 
  • An attractive salary and benefits package. 
  • A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
  • A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

jobs.description:
Senior Clinical Research Associate - Cardiovascular Medical Device

Status: Full-time, Exempt
Reports to: Senior Clinical Operations Manager
Location: Remote

Overview

VahatiCor is an early-stage cardiovascular medical device company developing break through cardiovascular technologies, including Class III catheter-based systems. We operate with a purpose-driven, agile, and collaborative culture, where each team member plays a meaningful role in advancing solutions that improve patient outcomes. As our clinical program grows, we are building a dedicated clinical operations team to support early feasibility studies and future pivotal trials.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) will own site activation, clinical study startup, site management, enrollment performance, and protocol execution across VahatiCor’s cardiovascular medical device clinical trials. This role serves as the primary operational partner to clinical sites, driving site readiness, investigator engagement, enrollment success, and consistent protocol execution throughout the study lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in sponsor-side medical device clinical research, clinical operations, site management, and early-stage medical device clinical trials.

Responsibilities

Site Activation & Study Startup

  • Lead site qualification, feasibility, and readiness activities for assigned cardiovascular medical device clinical trial sites.
  • Own clinical study startup and site activation activities, including collection and review of essential regulatory and startup documentation.
  • Ensure investigators, study coordinators, and site personnel are prepared to enroll patients efficiently and compliantly.
  • Partner with the Clinical Trials Manager and study leadership on site contracting and budgeting activities and ensure timely site activation.
  • Track startup milestones and proactively identify and resolve activation barriers.

Site Management & Enrollment

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned cardiovascular clinical trial sites.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with investigators, coordinators, and site personnel.
  • Drive patient screening and enrollment activities to achieve study recruitment goals.
  • Own site performance across assigned sites and implement actions to improve enrollment, protocol adherence, and study execution.
  • Partner with sites to address operational challenges and maintain study momentum.

Training & Clinical Study Execution

  • Conduct Site Initiation Visits (SIVs) and provide study-specific training to investigators and site personnel.
  • Deliver ongoing site education throughout study execution.
  • Ensure cardiovascular medical device clinical study activities are conducted in accordance with the protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), applicable FDA medical device regulations, and company procedures.
  • Participate in investigator meetings, study team meetings, and site training activities.

Clinical Trial Monitoring & Quality

  • Conduct clinical trial monitoring activities as required to ensure study quality, compliance, and protocol adherence.
  • Review site documentation and study records for completeness and accuracy.
  • Identify protocol deviations, compliance concerns, and operational risks and escalate appropriately.
  • Ensure site documentation is complete, accurate, maintained in accordance with study requirements, and inspection-ready at all times.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, and Quality to support effective study execution.
  • Communicate site feedback, enrollment trends, operational challenges, and emerging risks to study leadership.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of site activation, enrollment, and study execution processes.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 7+ years of clinical research experience supporting medical device clinical trials.
  • Sponsor-side medical device clinical research experience is required. Candidates whose experience is primarily CRO-based without direct sponsor-side medical device experience will not meet the requirements for this role.
  • Prior clinical operations experience within an early-stage medical device company is required.
  • Demonstrated experience owning clinical study startup, site activation, patient enrollment, and clinical trial execution activities.
  • Experience owning site qualification, Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), clinical trial monitoring, and site management activities.
  • Cardiovascular medical device clinical trial experience is highly valued, particularly experience with catheter-based or other interventional cardiovascular technologies.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA medical device regulations, and clinical research operations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 60% to conduct site startup, activation, training, monitoring, and study execution activities.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced, early-stage medical device environment where adaptability, initiative, and collaboration are critical to success.

Why Work for VahatiCor?

  • Help bring a first-of-its-kind therapy to patients with coronary microvascular dysfunction, a large and historically underserved patient population with limited treatment options.
  • Work alongside an experienced leadership team with deep expertise in cardiovascular medical devices, clinical research, regulatory affairs, and commercialization.
  • Make a visible impact in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where individual contributions directly influence the future of the technology, the clinical program, and the company.

Eligibility

Candidates must be permanently authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. We are currently unable to sponsor employment visas or permanent residency (PERM) applications.

Location and Compensation

This is a remote position supporting clinical sites throughout the Eastern United States. We are prioritizing candidates who reside in the Eastern or Central time zone and are located within reasonable proximity to a major airport to support travel requirements. Travel of up to 60% is required based on study and site needs.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $113,000 - $153,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors. VahatiCor is committed to fair and equitable pay practices. In addition to base salary, the total compensation package may include bonus opportunities, equity, and company-sponsored benefits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

VahatiCor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Third-Party Recruiter Notice

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or recruiters without a signed agreement in place. Any resumes submitted without such an agreement will be considered the property of VahatiCor and no fees will be paid if the candidate is hired. jobs.excerpt: Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases.
jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.description:
Non-Solicitation Policy and Notice to Agencies and Recruiters:

IDEAYA's Non-Solicitation Policy strictly prohibits agencies and recruiters from any contact and communication with IDEAYA employees, managers, and leaders to submit unsolicited candidate resumes and/or to solicit business partnerships. Submission of unsolicited candidate resumes by agencies or recruiters with or without a contract in place with IDEAYA Biosciences Inc. will not create any implied obligation. Failure to comply with this policy will result in disqualification from current and future business opportunities with IDEAYA Biosciences. All recruiting and talent agency decisions are strictly managed by the internal IDEAYA Human Resources function. All communication by external agencies and recruiters must be directed to . We ask that you only email your interest once.

Job Summary

About IDEAYA Biosciences:
IDEAYA is a precision medicine oncology company committed to the discovery, development, and commercialization of transformative therapies for cancer. Our approach integrates expertise in small-molecule drug discovery, structural biology and bioinformatics with robust internal capabilities in identifying and validating translational biomarkers to develop tailored, potentially first-in-class targeted therapies aligned to the genetic drivers of disease. We have built a deep pipeline of product candidates focused on synthetic lethality and antibody-drug conjugates, or ADCs, for molecularly defined solid tumor indications. Our mission is to bring forth the next wave of precision oncology therapies that are more selective, more effective, and deeply personalized with the goal of altering the course of disease and improving clinical outcomes for patients with cancer.

When you're at IDEAYA, you will be in the midst of brilliant minds working on precision medicine therapies to help cancer patients. We are passionate and committed about being on the forefront of oncology medicine, which means we all have a high internal drive that is at the very core of every person at IDEAYA. We are inquisitive, ask deep questions, and are data-driven innovators who like to collaborate and use team work to move science forward. For more information, please see www.ideayabio.com.

Location: Prefer candidates in Miami, Florida, but willing to consider candidates in Orlando, Florida.
*Territory coverage includes geography in the following states: Florida and Puerto Rico*

Position Summary:

IDEAYA is seeking Senior Oncology Account Managers (OAM) to join our Commercial team. The Senior Oncology Account Manager [OAM] serves as a strategic territory leader within a designated geographic region with responsibility for leading the launch and adoption of darovasertib within their assigned geography. The individual will act as a key conduit of clinical, scientific, and market intelligence related to darovasertib in uveal melanoma.

This role blends advanced scientific acumen with sophisticated account leadership to drive appropriate awareness and adoption within complex academic, community, and referral-based ecosystems. The Senior OAM operates with a high degree of autonomy, managing the most strategically important accounts and serving as a trusted partner to multidisciplinary healthcare stakeholders across the treatment landscape.

Through disciplined planning and enterprise collaboration, the Senior OAM builds durable relationships, activates referral pathways, and contributes meaningfully to regional and national commercial strategy. They will effectively balance outstanding execution in targeted, high-volume accounts with the need to ensure every patient can be considered for a new therapeutic option. The Senior OAM consistently adheres to internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining deep expertise in disease state management, evolving clinical data, the product package insert, and access considerations.

The Senior Oncology Account Manager reports to the Regional Business Director. This is a field-based role.


Reporting to: Senior Regional Business Director

Job Description

What you’ll do:

  • Demonstrate and maintain advanced knowledge of uveal melanoma, tumor biology, emerging clinical data, the competitive environment, and darovasertib's mechanism of action
  • Independently develop and execute sophisticated territory and ecosystem-level account strategies to drive appropriate product utilization
  • Leverage scientific knowledge and executive presence to cultivate peer-level relationships with leading academic oncologists, ocular specialists, and multidisciplinary stakeholders
  • Translate complex clinical data into clear, compliant, and compelling product education tailored to each stakeholder
  • Execute pre-launch and launch strategies in alignment with national brand objectives
  • Identify, activate, and optimize referral networks across the patient journey
  • Partner strategically with Medical Affairs, Value & Access, and Patient Services to optimally support complex accounts
  • Act as the voice of the customer, delivering actionable insights to key internal stakeholders informing brand strategy, lifecycle planning, and future launch readiness.
  • Effectively utilize multiple sources of analytics and performance data to optimize resource deployment and account prioritization and adapt execution plans accordingly
  • Adherence to all administrative requirements, including budget management, expense report management, CRM call reporting and synchronization, etc., within required timelines and company guidelines
  • Ensure all promotional activities adhere to regulatory and ethical standards
  • Travel: ~80%

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, biological sciences, or related discipline
  • Minimum 10 years pharmaceutical sales related experience; minimum 5+ years oncology sales experience
  • Proven success launching a first-in-class or specialty oncology product in the US
  • Experience in rare disease, orphan oncology, or highly specialized markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in high-level scientific dialogue with academic healthcare professionals
  • Possess comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process and fulfillment pathways for oral oncolytics and ability to partner internally and externally to support patient access to IDEAYA’s therapies.
  • Proven track record managing complex, high-impact academic and community oncology accounts
  • Strong analytic, strategic planning, and organizational skills
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and professionalism
  • Patient-centric mindset grounded in integrity and scientific rigor
  • Overnight travel corresponding to territory size and needs, including occasional evening and weekend work for conferences
  • Residence within assigned geographic region

Core Competencies

  • Scientific Credibility: Comfortable discussing complex mechanisms of action, clinical endpoints, and patient needs in an accessible and differentiated way
  • Complex Selling Capability: Skilled at multi-stakeholder engagement in a complex disease state
  • Collaboration: Thrives in cross-functional partnership within a lean organization
  • Analytical Rigor: Uses data to drive prioritization and resource allocation
  • Patient-Centric Mindset: Keeps patient needs at the heart of every decision
  • Execution Excellence: Delivers results with urgency, agility, quality, and compliance

All employees are expected to act with integrity and in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and IDEAYA policies, including IDEAYA’s Code of Conduct.

Employees must demonstrate good judgement and ethical behavior in all business activities, maintain patient and product safety as a top priority, and report any suspected violations of law or Company policy through appropriate channels

Total Rewards

Along with our inspiring mission, and highly collaborative and inclusive environment, IDEAYA offers a competitive total rewards package that reflects our pay-for-performance philosophy where employees are eligible to be considered for merit-based salary increases, company discretionary short-term incentive plan participation, and company discretionary stock option awards (based on board approval). Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but is not limited to, medical/dental/vision coverage (100% company paid for employees and 90% company paid for dependents), 401k, ESPP, and wellness programs.

The expected salary range for the role of Senior Oncology Account Manager is $187,000 - $231,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors that may include but are not limited to the office location where this open position is located, the final candidates’ experience within their profession, experience in the disease areas we are striving to make an impact in as a company, length of time within the industry, educational background, and performance during the interview process.

The Company complies with all laws respecting equal employment opportunities and does not discriminate against applicants with regard to any protected characteristic as defined by federal, state, and local law. This position requires you to work onsite in the office at the Company’s facilities for training & meetings, with work-from-home flexibility, and the Company requires that all employees working in its facilities be fully vaccinated (except as required by applicable law). Therefore, this position requires you to be fully vaccinated from COVID-19, subject to reasonable accommodations for medical or religious reasons, and/or as otherwise required by applicable law. The Company considers you fully vaccinated once 14 days have passed since you received either the second dose in a two-dose COVID-19 vaccine series or a single-dose COVID-19 vaccine. The vaccine must have been FDA approved, have emergency use authorization from the FDA, or, for persons fully vaccinated outside of the U.S., be listed for emergency use by the World Health Organization.
