jobs.title: VP, Enterprise APIs
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Vice President, API Technologies is a senior leader in the Chief Technology Office accountable for the strategy, product management, engineering, governance, modernization, and reliable operation of Humana’s enterprise API and integration ecosystem, spanning internal APIs, external partner and ecosystem APIs, and the shared platforms that enable them.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Vice President, API Technologies is a senior leader in the Chief Technology Office accountable for the strategy, product management, engineering, governance, modernization, and reliable operation of Humana’s enterprise API and integration ecosystem, spanning internal APIs, external partner and ecosystem APIs, and the shared platforms that enable them. As a dedicated enterprise function, this role leads APIs capabilities end to end, from standards, product strategy, the Unified API Gateway, and the Unified API Catalog through the enterprise-wide shift to a consumer-centric Omnichannel API model that delivers consistent, secure experiences across member, provider, associate, and partner touchpoints.
This leader runs APIs as products, treating API producers and consumers, internal and external, as customers. The VP owns the API product roadmap, lifecycle, investment priorities, adoption, reuse, health, and consumer experience. The VP is directly accountable for defining and creating Omnichannel APIs and for governing the modernization journey that migrates producers and consumers to modern, enterprise-aligned interfaces, while retiring redundant APIs, unsupported gateways, and legacy integration technologies.
The role also owns Humana’s external API strategy, including the secure exposure of APIs to partners and the broader ecosystem, technical management of API-enabled partnerships, partner certification and onboarding, and the heightened security, privacy, interoperability, support, and continuity requirements of external interfaces.
This is an AI-native function. The VP embeds AI into API design, delivery, governance, testing, and consumer migration, and establishes the enterprise approach for safely exposing approved API capabilities to AI agents through MCP and other emerging agent protocols where appropriate. The role is a primary enabler of interoperability, automation, resilient partner growth, and Humana’s 2030 Target State Architecture.

Scope of Accountability

- API Product Strategy & Management

API-as-a-product operating model, including product vision, roadmap, investment, adoption, reuse, consumer experience, value realization, and health metrics.

- API Standards, Governance & Security

Enterprise standards for REST, GraphQL, asynchronous messaging, event-driven APIs, and emerging protocols; full lifecycle governance; UAG and UAC; quality engineering; and API security in partnership with EIP.

- Omnichannel API Definition & Creation

Definition, design, and build of consumer-centric Omnichannel APIs aligned to consumer journeys and providing governed, consistent access to authoritative capabilities and data across channels.

- API Modernization: Producers & Consumers

Migration of producers and validated active consumers from legacy and point APIs to modern enterprise interfaces, including deprecation, retirement, dependency management, and progress reporting.

- External APIs, Partnerships & Governance

External API strategy, secure exposure, technical partnership management, certification, developer experience, data-use controls, interoperability compliance, continuity, and third-party API consumption.

- AI-Enabled API Governance & Execution

AI-assisted design, code generation, testing, compliance, and migration, plus risk-based MCP and agent-tool enablement with identity, authorization, human approval, auditability, and lifecycle controls.

- API Operations, Observability & Talent

Reliability engineering, SLOs, resilience, incident and problem management, developer enablement, workforce strategy, succession, capability building, and vendor/platform management.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Product Strategy & Management

  • Own the enterprise API product strategy and operating model, including a published roadmap, investment and funding model, lifecycle, value realization, adoption, reuse, and health metrics.

  • Treat API producers and consumers, internal and external, as customers and use structured voice-of-consumer feedback to prioritize high-leverage, business-critical API products.

  • Maintain a governed API product registry aligned to the Unified API Catalog, with clear ownership, product classification, lifecycle status, dependencies, and business outcomes.

  • Drive measurable reductions in point-to-point integrations, duplication, onboarding time, and cost to serve.

2. API Standards, Governance, Security & Quality Engineering

  • Own and evolve enterprise standards for REST, GraphQL, asynchronous messaging, event-driven APIs, and emerging integration protocols, with API security standards jointly owned with EIP.

  • Govern the full lifecycle through automated intake and controls covering design, documentation, schema validation, development, contract testing, security testing, performance testing, deployment, monitoring, versioning, deprecation, and retirement.

  • Advance the Unified API Gateway and Unified API Catalog, including discoverability, subscription management, reusable patterns, policy enforcement, and real-time governance and compliance reporting.

  • Operationalize zero-trust API security through approved identity and token standards, workload identity, fine-grained authorization, threat protection, secrets management, and OWASP API coverage in partnership with EIP.

  • Establish contract-first engineering, backward-compatibility requirements, consumer-driven contract testing, breaking-change detection, sandbox and mocking capabilities, and release-readiness controls.

3. Omnichannel API Definition & Creation

  • Define and create enterprise Omnichannel APIs aligned to consumer journeys, providing consistent, channel-agnostic access to authoritative capabilities and data across web, mobile, call center, IVR, agent, and partner channels.

  • Establish Omnichannel API design standards, reference patterns, and reusable building blocks so channels use governed enterprise interfaces rather than channel-specific, duplicative APIs.

  • Prioritize business-critical and high-leverage APIs that represent the majority of API volume, and design them with consumable schemas, metadata, documentation, and appropriate AI-agent readiness.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Data & Analytics so API contracts align to authoritative domain capabilities, enterprise information models, and governed data without creating competing sources of truth.

4. API Modernization: Producers & Consumers

  • Own and govern the enterprise API modernization program, sequencing migration of the legacy and fragmented API estate to modern enterprise and Omnichannel interfaces in prioritized waves.

  • Drive producer modernization and consumer migration, transitioning validated active consumers for approved, in-scope retirement candidates with backward compatibility, controlled cutover, rollback readiness, and minimal disruption.

  • Govern dependency discovery, retirement, deprecation, exception management, and the removal of redundant APIs, unsupported gateways, and legacy integration technologies.

  • Track producer modernization, consumer cutover, API retirement, platform adoption, reuse, risk, and business value through executive-visible reporting, using established baselines and data-quality controls.

5. External APIs, Partnerships & Governance

  • Own Humana’s external API strategy and the secure, standards-based exposure of APIs to partners, providers, vendors, and the broader ecosystem as a first-class product surface.

  • Lead the technical management of API-enabled partnerships, including partner segmentation, onboarding, certification and conformance testing, sandbox access, credentials and certificates, SLAs, versioning, support, escalation, and deprecation communications.

  • Establish heightened governance for partner identity, delegated authorization, fine-grained scopes, data sharing, minimum-necessary access, consent, privacy, PHI/PII protection, auditability, and applicable regulatory and interoperability obligations, including CMS and HL7 FHIR where relevant.

  • Govern third-party API consumption through technical due diligence, cataloging, dependency and concentration-risk monitoring, continuity planning, and exit or transition readiness.

  • Provide a governed external developer experience through an external portal, high-quality documentation, self-service onboarding where appropriate, production support, and observability at the edge.

  • Partner with business, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and other accountable functions on agreements and value-realization models, including monetization where strategically and legally appropriate.

6. AI-Enabled API Governance & Execution

  • Embed AI into API design, code generation, documentation, testing, standards validation, migration analysis, and consumer cutover to improve delivery speed and quality.

  • Establish the enterprise approach for safely exposing approved API capabilities to AI agents through MCP and other emerging agent protocols where appropriate, rather than requiring agent enablement for every API.

  • Govern MCP servers and agent tools through bounded tool design, strict schemas, workload and user identity, least-privilege authorization, secrets management, gateway and egress policy enforcement, audit trails, versioning, and deprecation controls.

  • Require human approval and appropriate rollback or recovery mechanisms for high-risk, write, destructive, or material business actions initiated by agents.

  • Apply risk-based governance to internally developed and third-party MCP servers, documenting exceptions and using compensating controls where direct implementation control is limited.

  • Partner with Enterprise AI and Cybersecurity to ensure responsible, secure, observable, and auditable use of AI across the API and integration lifecycle.

7. API Operations, Resilience, Observability & Talent

  • Own the production operating model for shared API platforms, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, capacity, quotas, throttling, dependency mapping, synthetic monitoring, and operational-readiness reviews.

  • Ensure resilience through continuity and disaster-recovery planning, tested failover and recovery procedures, release and rollback readiness, and risk-based multi-region or platform-resilience patterns where required.

  • Lead incident and problem management for shared platforms and critical enterprise interfaces, including timely detection, restoration, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and systemic learning.

  • Build API and integration developer enablement, product documentation, golden paths, communities of practice, and support models that improve adoption and engineering quality across segments.

  • Design and lead the API Technologies organization, including workforce and sourcing strategy, succession planning, leadership development, career paths, performance culture, and capability building across API product management, engineering, security, FHIR, operations, and AI-agent enablement.

  • Manage platform vendors, licensing, FinOps, enterprise-scale budgets, audit readiness, controls, and regulatory compliance.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 8+ years leading API, integration, platform engineering, or product organizations.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise API and integration strategy, product management, standards, governance, gateways, catalogs, event-driven architecture, messaging, streaming, and modern integration patterns.

  • Proven experience defining and governing external and partner APIs, including secure exposure, partner onboarding, certification, developer experience, agreements and SLAs, support, and regulatory compliance.

  • Proven success running APIs or platforms as products, including roadmap and investment ownership, adoption, reuse, consumer experience, value realization, and product health at enterprise scale.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale modernization across producers and consumers, retiring redundant services and legacy integration technologies with minimal disruption.

  • Experience applying AI and automation to API design, delivery, testing, governance, and migration, with knowledge of agentic integration patterns, MCP, or comparable emerging technologies.

  • Strong API and integration security acumen, including OAuth 2.x, approved token standards, workload identity, least privilege, zero-trust principles, secrets management, OWASP API risks, and external-facing authorization.

  • Demonstrated production leadership across reliability engineering, SLOs, resilience, incident and problem management, operational readiness, and continuity planning.

  • Proven organization leadership, including leading leaders, workforce strategy, succession planning, capability building, sourcing, and creation of high-performing product and engineering cultures.

  • Strong financial management and controls acumen, including multi-year investment planning, enterprise-scale budgets, vendor management, and regulated-environment accountability.

  • Exceptional executive stakeholder management and the ability to influence and align technology, business, risk, legal, and external-partner leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with API value-realization models, partner ecosystems, open or public API programs, and external developer platforms.

  • Hands-on familiarity with API gateway and catalog platforms, event and streaming technologies, GraphQL, and MCP.

  • Track record of enterprise-wide modernization, technical-debt reduction, middleware rationalization, and platform consolidation.

  • Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry, including interoperability standards such as CMS requirements and HL7 FHIR.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology. They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges.

The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships. They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership

The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations.
  • Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions.
  • Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.
  • Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services.
  • Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.
  • Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus

Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance

  • Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities.
  • Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management

  • Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs.
  • Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.
  • Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs.

Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance

  • Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.
  • Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications.
  • Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth

  • Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams.
  • Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.
  • Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency.
  • Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time.
  • Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally.

Preferred

  • Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.
  • Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness. They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark

Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands. This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution.

Job Description

With support of other Clinical Research Manager's (CRMs) and/or Therapeutic Area Head (TAH) / Clinical Research Director (CRD), this role is accountable for the end-to-end performance and project management for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP) and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.

The Associate Clinical Research Manager (aCRM) could be responsible for a particular study for a country or a cluster.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Main Point of Contact (POC) for assigned protocols and link between Country Operations and clinical trial team (CTT).
  • Responsible for project management of the assigned studies: pro-actively plans, drives and tracks execution and performance of deliverables/timelines/results to meet country commitments from feasibility and site selection, recruitment, execution and close out.
  • Accountable for performance for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.
  • Reviews Monitoring Visits Reports and escalates performance issues and training needs to Clinical Research Associate Manager (CRAM) and/or functional vendor and internal management as needed.
  • Performs Quality control visits as required.
  • Leads local study teams to high performance: trains in the protocol other local roles, closely collaborates with and supports CRAs as protocol expert and coordinates activities across the different local country roles ensuring a strong collaboration (including the Clinical Trial Coordinators (CTC), Clinical Research Associates' (CRAs) and Clinical Operations Managers (COMs).
  • Responsible for creating and executing a local risk management plan for assigned studies.
  • Ensures compliance with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) and other key systems in assigned studies.
  • Escalates as needed different challenges and issues to TA-Head/CRD/ Country Clinical Quality Manager (CCQM) and or CTT (as appropriate).
  • Identifies and shares best practices.
  • Responsible for collaboration with functional outsourcing vendors, investigators, other external partners in assigned studies.
  • As a customer-facing role, this position will build business relationships and represent our company with investigators.
  • Supports local and regional strategy development consistent with long‐term corporate needs in conjunction with CRD, TA-Head and Regional Operations.
  • Collaborates internally with Headquarters (HQ) functions, regional and local operations, European Union (EU) Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Global Medical and Scientific Affairs to align on key issues/decisions across the trials. Consult with Human Health as needed.

Extent of Travel: Up to 30% of working time.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Skills:

  • Knowledge in Project Management and/or site management.
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated success in related role or discipline required.
  • Requires ability to make decisions independently and oversee important activities relevant to clinical research activities according to predetermined global policies and commitments with the support, oversight and supervision of the TA-Head or CRD
  • Requires understanding of local regulatory environment.
  • Scientific and clinical research knowledge is required.
  • Understanding of clinical trial planning, management and metrics is essential as well as the ability to focus on multiple deliverables and protocols simultaneously.
  • Ability to function as a key link between Country Operations and Clinical Trial Teams
  • Communicates effectively and builds a collaboration spirit in a remote/virtual environment and across countries, cultures and functions.
  • Ability to manage processes (and controls), productivity, quality and project delivery.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English and local language. The incumbent must be competent and effective in written and verbal communication.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote and virtual environment.
  • Aptitude for building leadership skills that enable and drive alignment with the goals, purpose and mission of our Research & Development Division, Global Clinical Development (GCD) and Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO).
  • Ability to identify problems, conflicts and opportunities early, analyses and prepare mitigation plans and drive conflict resolution is critical.
  • Required to negotiate skillfully in tough situations with both internal and external groups; settle differences with minimum disruption.
    • Examples of common problems include:
      • 1) low patient recruitment
      • 2) inadequate staff to meet business needs
      • 3) performance or compliance issues
      • 4) resolution of conflictive situations.
  • Understand cultural differences.
  • Strong diplomatic and empathic skills to effectively build and maintain professional relationships with investigators and other stakeholders.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science (or comparable)
  • 4+ years of experience in clinical research
  • CRA experience preferred
  • Immunology experience preferred

Adaptability, Clinical Research, Clinical Trials Operations, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, External Partners, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH GCP Guidelines, Project Management, Quality Management, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, Strategic Planning, Verbal Communications

Preferred Skills:

Clinical Study Management, Cross-Cultural Awareness, Deliverables Management, Immunology, Relationship Building

Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

The COA Product and Insights Manager serves as the senior insights and intelligence lead within Wiley's Clinical Outcomes Assessment (COA) Solutions business. The role provides market intelligence, portfolio analytics and competitive insight to inform product strategy, partnership targeting and commercial positioning. It combines hands-on analytical work with cross-functional partnership, working closely with the Senior Product Manager, the broader COA leadership team, and colleagues across IP and Licensing, Product Delivery, Commercial and Scientific functions to ensure decisions are grounded in robust evidence. The role will also establish scalable datasets, dashboards and AI-assisted workflows that strengthen ongoing intelligence capability across the business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead market intelligence and competitive analysis across the COA market, tracking competitor offerings, pricing, positioning, regulatory developments, clinical trial patterns, therapeutic area dynamics and emerging trends.
  • Analyse Wiley's COA portfolio against external demand signals, including clinical trial usage data, label claim precedent, regulatory submissions and competitor catalogues, to identify underleveraged assets, portfolio gaps and opportunities for acquisition, development or repositioning.
  • Translate market and portfolio analysis into clear recommendations that inform product roadmap decisions, instrument prioritisation, partnership targeting and commercial positioning.
  • Build and maintain the datasets, dashboards and analytical tooling that support ongoing intelligence work, ensuring outputs are reproducible, defensible and accessible, and applying AI-assisted workflows where they add value.
  • Benchmark competitor pricing, packaging and positioning to identify pricing opportunities and competitive threats and to support decisions about how Wiley structures, prices and positions its solutions.
  • Partner across IP and Licensing, Product Delivery, Product, Commercial and Scientific teams to ensure insight informs decisions across the business, while surfacing emerging market and regulatory signals and contributing to thought leadership where commercially or strategically useful.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in product management, market intelligence, business analysis, commissioning, research or a comparable analytical and commercially oriented role, with some experience in publishing, healthcare, life sciences or a research-adjacent environment.
  • Strong analytical capability, including experience working with structured and unstructured data, querying public datasets and synthesising disparate sources into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Hands-on capability with technical tooling, including SQL, Python or equivalent, together with working fluency in AI-assisted analytical workflows and judgement about where they add value.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, such as life sciences, data science, business, economics, social sciences or humanities.

Department: Advanced Power Systems (APS). This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management System IC Architecture for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary System IC Architect with deep expertise in system-level architecture, high-performance power conversion, and semiconductor packaging technologies. This role is pivotal in defining next-generation Point of Load (PoL) solutions for APS, driving innovation in advanced power management with System-in-Package (SiP) integration.

We’re looking for a candidate to define products, shape architecture strategy, and support the launch of Point-of-Load (PoL) power solutions that meet latest system-level requirements. Key focus areas include high-performance core power for automotive applications and AI compute platforms. The role centers on Advanced Power Management for PoL solutions. Expertise in AI compute power is essential, and experience in automotive power management is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities – Advanced Power Management & System IC Architecture

Product Definition & Strategy

  • Own System IC Architecture, to define product concepts and specifications for power semiconductor modules and System-in-Package (SiP) solutions. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Develop and maintain long-term product and technology roadmaps in collaboration with product line leaders and R&D teams.

  • Translate customer requirements into innovative packaging and power management solutions. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Support development through thermal optimization and electrical analysis.

System-Level Integration

  • Partner with system solution architects and IC product architects to ensure solutions meet stringent performance, efficiency, space, and cost targets.

  • Lead integration of ICs and power semiconductors into advanced packages and systems. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions. Expertise in System-in-Package (SiP) integration is essential.

  • Drive early-phase engineering and architecture for AI compute, automotive 48V systems, and electrification platforms. Knowledge of AI Compute Power Solutions is critical. Automotive Power Management experience is a plus, highly valued.

Thermal Management & Advisory

  • Analyze customer-specific needs to deliver optimized power efficiency and thermal management strategies for enhanced reliability. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with system, modeling, design, packaging and manufacturing engineering teams to validate and optimize high-performance compute Power designs.

  • Act as a technical liaison with customers, supporting co-development and design-in activities.

Technical Advisory & Reporting

  • Provide strategic insights on state-of-the-art power management technologies and benchmark readiness. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Report KPIs and project status to executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications – Power Semiconductor Architect Expertise

  • Master’s degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).

  • 15+ years of experience in power semiconductors, packaging, and system-level integration. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions. Expertise in System-in-Package (SiP) integration is essential.

  • Proven track record in product definition through revenue realization.

  • Strong expertise in thermal management, electrical performance, and advanced reliability.

  • Proficiency in circuit simulation tools (e.g., Cadence Spectre, PSPICE, HSPICE, Saber, Simetrix/Simplis, Verilog-AMS) and knowledge of PCB materials and stack-up.

  • Experience in Powering high performance compute SoC platforms, with automotive-grade standards highly valued.

  • Experience in systems developed according to Functional Safety standard is a plus (ISO26262 and/or IEC61508).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage complex projects.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate across diverse teams.

  • Creative mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

  • Willingness to travel globally.

Location:

This position can be done from anywhere in the United States and is open to 100% remote, however some travel to our Chandler site where the team sits will be required each quarter in addition to any necessary customer visits. This position is also open to locations in EMEA and especially France.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As the Indirect Contracting Team Leader (f/m/d), you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end management of indirect customer contracts across PDx International. You will lead a team of contract specialists and ensure that distributor, wholesaler and sales representative contracts are in place, effectively managed, renewed on time, and fully compliant with applicable laws, regulations, and internal GE HealthCare policies.

This role is critical in strengthening and sustaining the indirect contracting control environment across PDx International. It requires strong contract management expertise, sound judgment, people leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive transformation in a complex, cross-functional environment. The role will focus on standard work, lean processes, measurable performance management, governance, and sustainable remediation of contract lifecycle risks.

The role is responsible for operational contract lifecycle management and governance. Legal interpretation, advice, risk assessments, and approval of substantive contractual deviations remain the responsibility of the Legal function. The same applies to PDx Compliance.

The role is open for hybrid, remote, or onsite set-up in any European country.

At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Indirect Contract Management:

  • Lead the end-to-end operational management of the contract life cycle for distributor, wholesaler and sales representative contracts. This will include drafting, review, execution, renewal, amendment, extension, and termination in close coordination with particularly Commercial, Regulatory, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Ensure contract coverage, expiry dates, status, renewal timelines, key obligations, comprehensive and accurate contract repository, and remediation actions are accurately tracked, maintained, and audit-ready.
  • Identify indirect third parties operating without valid contract coverage and drive risk-based remediation, including prioritization of expired or at-risk contracts.
  • Partner with Commercial, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to manage customers without valid contract coverage according to agreed controls, escalation pathways, ordering restrictions, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure compliant execution and lifecycle management of third-party commercial contracts by enforcing approved templates, completing required due diligence and compliance reviews, and coordinating necessary legal, regulatory, trade compliance, privacy, competition law, and anti-corruption assessments. Ensure timely escalation of material risks, deviations, and approval requirements in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.
  • Decision-making authority includes operational prioritization of contract renewals and team workload, workflow management, governance reporting, escalation of identified risks, and driving process improvements in alignment with relevant support functions. Approval of contractual deviations, policy exceptions, and legal or compliance positions remains with the designated approving functions.

Team Leadership and Operational Execution:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of contract specialists, ensuring clear priorities, high-quality execution, and consistent ways of working.
  • Set expectations for process adherence, documentation quality, stakeholder responsiveness, compliance with internal standards, and Daily Management.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex contracting topics, lapsed coverage, renewal prioritization, delays, deviations, and cross-functional alignment needs.
  • Train and build team capability and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Compliance, Risk Management and Governance:

  • Ensure indirect customer contracts comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, SOPs, approval requirements, and GE HealthCare compliance standards.
  • Strengthen the contracting control environment through contract coverage, renewal governance, role clarity, process adherence, and effective risk escalation.
  • Define and maintain clear roles and responsibilities, including RACI for contract review, approval, renewal, escalation, and cross-functional decision-making.
  • Establish governance routines to review overdue actions, upcoming renewals, lapsed coverage, extensions, deviations, risks, process adherence, audit readiness, and remediation progress.
  • Support internal investigations, audit activities, compliance reviews, and management responses relating to indirect contracting activities.

Process Transformation and Lean Standard Work:

  • Transform the indirect contracting process toward a standardized, lean, transparent, and well-controlled operating model.
  • Redesign the contract renewal lifecycle with clear initiation triggers, process maps, approval pathways, standard handoffs, and defined ownership embedding mandatory function specific review checkpoints and deviation escalation.
  • Implement standard work, templates, process documentation, operating rhythms, and Daily Management across PDx International.
  • Drive adoption of contract lifecycle management technologies, data quality standards, automation opportunities, and reporting capabilities to improve efficiency, transparency, and risk management. Continuously improve routines to increase transparency, reduce email-based follow-up, improve action ownership, and reduce waste, waiting times, rework, and complexity.

Management System, KPIs and Performance Tracking:

  • Build and maintain a management system for indirect contracting, including KPIs, dashboards, performance reviews, action tracking, and governance routines.
  • Monitor contract lifecycle performance, including contracts executed before expiry, renewal cycle duration, extensions, lapsed coverage, overdue actions, deviations, backlog, and remediation progress.
  • Use data insights to identify bottlenecks, gaps, and process failures, and translate them into prioritization, escalation, resource allocation, and improvement actions.
  • Provide regular updates on performance, contract coverage, risks, remediation actions, efficiency improvements, and transformation milestones.

Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Build strong relationships with all relevant support functions, such as Compliance, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, Sales Managers, and regional leadership teams.
  • Align stakeholders on contracting priorities, process requirements, risk management expectations, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation points.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive contracting matters clearly and effectively, helping build consensus across functions.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for indirect contracting topics, escalations, governance discussions, remediation actions, and transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Significant experience in contract drafting and management, commercial contracting, legal operations, public procurement, commercial operations, or a related field, preferably within healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics, medical technology, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience managing distributor networks, working within regulated healthcare, leading cross-border contracting teams, implementing governance frameworks and responding to internal or external audits is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, distributor or indirect customer contracting, compliance requirements, risk management, internal controls, and governance frameworks within regulated healthcare.
  • Proven ability to lead a team, set priorities, drive accountability, manage operational execution, and build team capability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead process transformation, standardization, lean initiatives, Daily Management, continuous improvement, and operational excellence programs.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define KPIs, create performance transparency, interpret operational data, identify gaps, and drive improvement actions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to align relevant support functions, such as Compliance, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, Sales, and senior business stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail, strong organizational discipline, and commitment to quality, compliance, documentation accuracy, process adherence, and audit readiness.
  • Ability to operate with sound judgment, autonomy, and ownership while operating effectively within defined decision-making boundaries, managing competing priorities, resolving complex issues, and driving decisions across countries and functions.
  • Demonstrated experience in operating across multiple jurisdictions, cultures, and regulatory environments in a global or regional organization.
  • Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence adoption of new processes, manage resistance, and sustain behavioural change across stakeholder groups.
  • Lean, project management, process excellence, workflow transformation, or contract lifecycle system experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with contract workflows, lifecycle and the respective IT tools (such as Salesforce.com) are highly advantageous.
  • Fluent English is required. Additional languages relevant to PDx International are a plus.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the centre of an ecosystem working toward precision health – digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics business is the number one global supplier of contrast media and molecular imaging agents used to enhance medical imaging exams. ​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior Brand & Marketing Lead – Premium Hospitality

Compensation range: $2000 AUD - $3000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

Our client is a premium hospitality and events business delivering high-end food experiences across weddings, private functions, and corporate events in Australia. Known for combining elevated service with detail-focused execution, the business works closely with event planners, luxury venues, and lifestyle brands to create polished guest experiences in fast-paced environments.

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a commercially minded Marketing Strategy & Campaigns Manager who can take ownership of the marketing function across strategy, creative direction, campaign planning and execution.

This is a hands-on role within a growing business. You’ll be responsible for turning commercial objectives and new initiatives into clear, compelling go-to-market strategies that drive qualified enquiries, bookings, revenue and stronger customer engagement.

The ideal person is both a strategic marketer and a mini creative director — someone who can see the bigger picture, develop the strategy, and then get into the detail to make sure the execution is strong, on-brand and commercially effective.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Build and own the 12-month marketing calendar, identifying key campaigns, seasonal moments, launches and initiatives.
  • Align marketing activity with commercial objectives, sales priorities and broader business goals.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and recommend marketing priorities rather than waiting for briefs.
  • Keep internal and external stakeholders aligned on upcoming campaigns, priorities, timelines and deliverables.

Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Take a commercial objective, product, service or new initiative and develop the go-to-market strategy from concept through execution.
  • Define:
    • Target audience and customer segments
    • Positioning and key messaging
    • Campaign concept and creative direction
    • Channel strategy
    • Content and creative requirements
    • Partnership opportunities
    • Indicative budgets
    • KPIs and measurement
    • Launch and execution timeline
  • Develop structured launch plans that clearly communicate what needs to happen, when and why.

Creative Direction

  • Act as a strong mini creative director, setting the creative direction for campaigns and brand initiatives.
  • Brief and collaborate with photographers, designers, content creators and other creative partners.
  • Review creative output and provide clear, constructive feedback.
  • Ensure all creative work is high-quality, commercially effective and consistent with the brand.
  • Understand when creative work is not strong enough and confidently push for a better result.

Commercial Marketing

  • Connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes, including:
    • Qualified enquiries
    • Bookings
    • Revenue
    • Customer acquisition
    • Customer behaviour
    • Partnership opportunities
  • Develop KPIs that go beyond reach, impressions, followers and content volume.
  • Monitor campaign performance and use insights to improve future activity.
  • Make commercially informed recommendations around budget allocation and channel investment.

Hands-on Execution

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Be comfortable getting into the detail when required, particularly in a small-business environment.
  • Coordinate campaign deliverables, timelines, stakeholders and external suppliers.
  • Ensure campaigns move from strategy to execution without losing focus or quality.

Example of What Success Looks Like

A key example is Pronto, which has recently been soft launched.

For an initiative like this, we want the person in this role to be able to independently develop a clear 90-day go-to-market plan, including:

  • Who we should target and why
  • How Pronto should be positioned in the market
  • The core campaign idea and creative direction
  • What photography, video, design and other assets are required
  • How the launch should be structured over 90 days
  • Which marketing channels should be prioritised
  • Potential partnerships and collaboration opportunities
  • Recommended budget and where it should be allocated
  • KPIs and how we will determine whether the launch is working
  • Recommendations for optimisation based on performance

The expectation is that they can take a relatively open-ended commercial opportunity and turn it into a clear, actionable marketing plan.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is not simply a content or social media manager. They are a commercial marketer who can think strategically, lead creative direction and execute.

They should be able to walk into an ambiguous opportunity, ask the right questions, identify the commercial objective, develop the strategy, brief the creative work, coordinate execution and ultimately measure whether the activity delivered a meaningful business outcome.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Deliver and maintain a clear 12-month marketing calendar.
  • Develop strong go-to-market strategies for new initiatives and campaigns.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of brand and creative output.
  • Generate qualified enquiries and contribute to bookings and revenue.
  • Build effective partnerships and campaign opportunities.
  • Establish clear KPIs and reporting for marketing initiatives.
  • Proactively identify and recommend new opportunities.
  • Successfully take campaigns from strategy → creative → launch → measurement → optimisation.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Title:

Information System Security Officer (ISSO)

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Job Summary

The successful candidate will provide support to the Test Resource Management Center’s (TRMC) All Domain Test Range (ADTR) and INDOPACOM Pacific-Rim Multi-Domain Training and Experimentation Capability Team, Joint Mission Environment Test Capability (JMETC) Secret Network (JSN) Node, JMETC Multiple Independent Levels of Security Network (JMN) Node, Secret Defense Research and Engineering Network (SDREN), Defense Research and Engineering Network (DREN).

In this role, you will be a critical part of our team responsible for evaluating customer requirements pertaining to complex technical challenges. The successful candidate will assist with providing solutions to complex problems in a manner which meets both functional and security requirements. You will be responsible for keeping the team’s computing environment operational and in compliance with all TRMC directives and applicable RMF requirements. To do this you will frequently collaborate with other distributed team members to discuss current system status and plan desired future enhancements.

The ideal candidate will have a blended skill set with a strong background in both systems administration and cybersecurity. This individual will possess experience in Windows and Linux server management, Active Directory, Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and virtualization technologies. This role is critical in ensuring the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our information systems within a Department of Defense (DoD) environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Management:
    • Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, and standards to safeguard organizational information systems.
    • Conduct regular security assessments, vulnerability scans, and penetration testing to identify and mitigate potential threats.
    • Monitor security alerts and logs to respond to incidents in a timely manner, ensuring compliance with DoD regulations.
    • Manage Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions to ensure secure access control for sensitive systems and data.
    • Filter and generate reports from Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools to provide insights into security incidents and trends.
    • Respond to JFHQ-DODIN issued orders, such as Cyber Task Orders (CTO).
    • Participate in DoD mandated Zero Trust efforts (initiatives, planning, testing and implementation).
  • Systems Administration
    • Administer Windows and Linux servers, ensuring optimal performance, security and uptime.
    • Manage Active Directory for user account provisioning, authentication, and access control, ensuring compliance with organizational security policies.
    • Implement and maintain STIGs to harden system configurations and reduce vulnerabilities across all server environments.
  • Virtualization and Cloud Management
    • Oversee the virtualization of servers using VMware, Hyper-V, or similar technologies, ensuring secure and efficient resource allocation.
    • Manage cloud-based services and applications, ensuring they adhere to security policies and best practices.
  • Risk Management Framework (RMF) Compliance
    • Apply RMF principles to assess and manage risk associated with information systems, including categorization, selection of security controls, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure all systems are RMF-compliant and maintain relevant documentation.
  • Training and Awareness
    • Develop and conduct security training programs for staff to enhance awareness of information security best practices and organizational policies.
    • Function as a security advisor to other departments, providing guidance on secure system design and implementation.
  • Documentation and Reporting
    • Maintain comprehensive documentation of security processes, incidents, and remediation efforts.
    • Prepare and present reports on security posture, vulnerabilities, and incident response efforts to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Additional Tools and Technologies
    • Experience with McAfee ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO) for centralized security management.
    • Familiarity with Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) for vulnerability scanning and compliance monitoring.

Work Environment:

  • Location: Remote
  • Travel Requirements: [Minimal 10-20%)
  • Working Hours: Standard

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CASP, Security+
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI
  • Experience: Minimum 10 years of system administration or cybersecurity-related experience, specifically within DoD environment.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficient in Windows server and Linux server management, including installation, security policies, configuration, and troubleshooting.

Desired:

  • Education: Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (CISSP, CISM, CASP, Security+)
  • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure: Horizon, UAG, Provision and Maintain VM pools
  • Client Support: Solid understanding and experience supporting zero/thin clients
  • Risk Management System Support: Experience supporting systems within a DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) accredited environment.
  • SIEM Solutions: Splunk, SolarWinds, etc.
  • Skills: Coordination, Communication and Presentation skills
  • Functionality: Layer 2/3 Networking experience
  • Firewall experience
  • DoD 8570 certifications: Security+, CISSP, Computing Environment
  • DoD Network experience: Experience working with DoD Wide Area Networks and familiarity with various network architectures and common protocols to include:
    • Experience working with Defense Research and Engineering Network (DREN)
    • Experience working with the Secret Defense Research and Engineering Network (SDREN)
    • EPO (Trelix) experience – policy, agent updates, compliance dashboards, ACAS experience – scanning, reporting, compliance dashboards

The right candidate understands current architectural patterns and industry trends well enough to evaluate tradeoffs, ask good questions during technical planning, and bring informed perspective into prioritization decisions.

  • Partner with the Product Manager and stakeholders to define and maintain business requirements, use cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Develop a working understanding of the data platform architecture, ingestion patterns, data models, and governance frameworks, sufficient to scope work accurately and ask the right questions

  • Lead sprint planning and refinement sessions; work with engineers, analysts, and QA to scope work and estimate effort

The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. jobs.excerpt: About UsWe are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.

What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.

If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.

Why this role exists

Communications for the aging in America are broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." James Graham started this company after seeing his own grandmother get taken advantage of by the large telecom hegemony.

They are checking her bank account daily because they cannot tell if she is being scammed. They are calling three times a day because she did not pick up and they do not know if she is okay. They are lying awake wondering if she is connected to anyone, or just sitting alone. And at the most basic level, a lot of their phone service is completely unreliable or breaks entirely for the family once she reaches a certain age.

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone.

Community Phone solves that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, no setup required. We wrapped it with AI-powered check-in calls that surface how she is really doing. And we built a family app integrated to Mom’s phone that replaces daily dread with genuine safety and peace of mind.

It is working. We are well into 8-figure subscription ARR, pacing to 9-figure, with 30,000+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply to them. Customers stay. They refer their friends. They tell us we took away an anxiety they had carried for years.

We are a lean, product-driven team. The people who thrive here take full ownership, are mission-driven, move quickly, hyper-curious, and care deeply about the customer. One of our product engineers won an Oscar for best foreign film, one team member is a Thiel Fellow, one is a Harvard Philosophy PhD dropout, others are the first growth hires at now-unicorn companies, others of our product engineers are former leaders of 60+ person engineering organizations, and many are former founders.

What you'll own

  • Set design strategy across the full customer journey - physical unboxing, mobile app, web dashboard, agentic ai voice check ins, etc - treating them as one coherent customer story end to end with clearly divided responsibilities, not surfaces competing for the same features or moments of customer attention throughout time.
  • Own outcomes past first activation. At this scale, getting someone through setup is only half the job - you'll be on the team accountable for adoption impact (AI check-in calls, call forwarding, spam blocking, call monitoring & safety features) and the metrics that show whether customers actually get value, in partnership with growth and PLG-focused teams. You are constantly learning post launch about how launched design can be improved.
  • Mock up full working prototypes: You should be completely fluent with modern AI development tools and be able to show full working mockups quickly. To the team. To customers in the ICP. To the CEO. You are AI optimistic and not AI psychotic.
  • Build the foundations a growing design org will need: a shared component language across app, dashboard, AI & sound interface, a research and testing habit (especially with lower-tech-literacy and senior users), and documentation that lets non-designers make good small decisions without you in the room.
  • Operate as a strategic partner to leadership, not just an execution arm - you'll be in the room when roadmap and prioritization decisions get made, and expected to have nonobvious points of view grounded in the reality of the product experience for customers.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including meaningful senior ownership at a company operating at real scale (think $20M+ ARR, multiple interconnected products or surfaces, an active PLG or self-serve growth motion). This is probably not the right first senior role for someone whose experience so far has been entirely at seed or Series A complexity.
  • Demonstrated design leadership and strategic influence - you've shaped product and company strategy as a peer to engineering and product leadership, whether or not you formally managed other designers.
  • Experience improving onboarding and activation for a genuinely complex, multi-surface product (e.g., physical + app + web + ai voice interaction, or several interlocking funnels), where you had to make real trade-offs rather than apply a generic simplification playbook.
  • World class UI, UX, and user research skills.
  • Excellent taste.
  • Superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. This work reveals truths in the world that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as it is a pursuit of beauty. It is a pursuit of simplicity but not over-simplicity. It understands people as they are and how they change. It reveals parts of the user to themselves. Building products that capture these qualities is exceptionally hard. And the people who can do it seem to possess these three character qualities to a high degree.
  • The judgment to operate as the entire design function today - setting your own priorities against company goals and communicating decisions clearly to non-design stakeholders.
  • Ability to establish a life and death level of trust with product engineers. Some of the engineers we’ve hired have great design taste. The person right for this role will see that, take advantage of it, and push and be pushed together.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for hardware unboxing or physical + digital product setup (IoT, consumer electronics, medical devices, or similar).
  • Experience with caregiving, eldercare, accessibility-focused, or health-adjacent consumer products with multiple types of users.
  • Prior experience both as an early/founding designer and later at a scaled company - you understand the difference and know which muscles this stage actually requires.

How we work

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset - we'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly into the Founder CEO and have a very direct line from your design decisions to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right.

Compensation & benefits

  • Base salary: $185,000 - $235,000
  • Equity
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage (U.S.-based employees)
  • 401(k)
  • Life insurance
  • Team offsites

How to apply

Send us your portfolio with at least one case study that shows strategic thinking, not just polished screens - ideally one where you navigated real product or organizational complexity, not a green-field MVP. Tell us briefly why designing for this kind of customer, at this kind of stage, is interesting to you.

Job Title: Patient Care Coordinator (Physical Therapy)

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Daylight Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $5 - $6 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

We are seeking a reliable, highly organized, and patient-focused Physical Therapy Patient Care Coordinator to provide virtual reception, patient coordination, clinical documentation, and administrative support for a busy U.S.-based physical therapy practice.

As a key point of contact for patients, you will help create a smooth and positive experience from the moment they call the practice. You will manage inbound patient calls in real time, answer general inquiries, route calls appropriately, coordinate appointments, return missed calls, and provide timely appointment reminders and confirmations.

A significant part of this role also involves clinical documentation and charting. You will take accurate notes, summarize patient sessions, and assist with maintaining complete and organized clinical records using WebPT. Because this position combines patient-facing responsibilities with documentation, the ideal candidate can confidently transition between phone calls, scheduling, charting, and administrative tasks while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

The practice serves patients across different age groups, including older adults. We are looking for someone who communicates with patience, empathy, and professionalism and understands how important a positive patient experience is in a physical therapy setting.

If you have healthcare experience, excellent communication skills, and a passion for helping patients while keeping clinical operations organized, we'd love to hear from you.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Patient Communication & Virtual Reception

  • Answer inbound patient calls in real time and address general inquiries
  • Route calls appropriately using RingCentral
  • Monitor and promptly return missed calls
  • Communicate professionally with patients via phone and text
  • Provide clear, patient, and empathetic assistance, particularly when supporting older patients
  • Follow established scripts and procedures when handling patient communications

Clinical Documentation & WebPT Support

  • Take accurate notes and assist with clinical documentation and charting in WebPT
  • Summarize patient sessions accurately for clinical records
  • Maintain complete, organized, and accurate patient information
  • Support clinicians with documentation-related administrative tasks
  • Ensure patient information is entered accurately and handled with appropriate confidentiality

Appointment Scheduling & Patient Follow-Up

  • Schedule and manage patient appointments
  • Send appointment reminders and confirmations through RingCentral and AppToto
  • Follow up with patients regarding upcoming or missed appointments
  • Maintain an accurate and organized appointment schedule
  • Follow established scheduling scripts, workflows, and procedures

Insurance & Administrative Support

  • Assist with insurance eligibility verification
  • Support insurance authorization processes
  • Complete administrative paperwork and documentation
  • Maintain organized patient records and information
  • Provide general virtual front-office and back-office support
  • Assist with additional patient coordination and administrative responsibilities as needed

Top 3 Priorities

1. Virtual Reception & Patient Call Management

Answer inbound patient calls in real time, address inquiries professionally, route calls through RingCentral, and return missed calls promptly while delivering an excellent patient experience.

2. Clinical Documentation & Charting

Complete accurate note-taking, patient session summaries, and charting within WebPT. Maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail when working with clinical information.

3. Appointment Management & Patient Follow-Up

Coordinate patient appointments and send timely reminders and confirmations through RingCentral and AppToto while consistently following the practice's established workflows and scripts.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

Healthcare & Patient Coordination Experience

  • Previous experience working in the healthcare industry is required
  • Experience in a physical therapy, rehabilitation, medical, or similar patient-care environment is strongly preferred
  • Previous experience as a Patient Care Coordinator, Physical Therapy Coordinator, Medical Receptionist, Medical Virtual Assistant, or similar role is an advantage
  • Comfortable working with medical terminology, patient information, and healthcare documentation

Patient Communication & Phone Support

  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills
  • Strong professional phone etiquette and customer service skills
  • Experience handling inbound patient calls and inquiries
  • Comfortable managing frequent patient calls while completing scheduling, documentation, and administrative tasks
  • Patient, compassionate, and professional when communicating with patients
  • Comfortable assisting older patient populations
  • Able to communicate clearly through phone and text

Clinical Documentation

  • Experience with clinical documentation, charting, medical note-taking, or patient records is strongly preferred
  • Ability to accurately summarize patient information and sessions
  • Exceptional attention to detail when documenting clinical information
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills
  • Able to maintain accurate and organized patient records

Scheduling & Administrative Support

  • Experience with patient scheduling, appointment confirmations, and follow-ups
  • Familiarity with insurance verification and authorization processes is preferred
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills
  • Ability to balance calls, documentation, scheduling, and administrative responsibilities throughout the day
  • Able to consistently follow established scripts, workflows, and procedures

Systems & Software Experience

The practice currently uses:

  • WebPT – Primary EHR and clinical documentation platform
  • RingCentral – Phone, call routing, and patient communication
  • AppToto – Appointment reminders and confirmations

Hands-on WebPT experience is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates with experience using other EHR/EMR systems and strong clinical documentation skills are encouraged to apply.

Experience with RingCentral, AppToto, or similar communication and appointment management platforms is also an advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in healthcare administration and patient coordination
  • Familiar with physical therapy or rehabilitation workflows, ideally
  • An excellent English communicator with strong phone etiquette
  • Confident handling real-time patient calls
  • Comfortable balancing patient communication with clinical documentation
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Accurate and thorough when entering patient information
  • Patient, empathetic, and compassionate
  • Reliable, proactive, and consistent
  • Able to work independently as a dedicated full-time team member
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment
  • Tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Adaptable and able to consistently follow established workflows and procedures

Basic Requirements

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Educational qualifications

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.
