And while our organization is fully remote, we are proud of the people-focused culture we have built and the connectedness of our team.

We work on serious issues, take our mission seriously, but never take ourselves too seriously.

Through political events, conferences, and business roundtables, United engages key decision-makers around the benefits that advanced energy technologies and services can provide to their constituents and helps to solve the challenges in obtaining these benefits.

Reporting directly to the Policy Senior Director, the Policy Principal will cultivate relationships and inform strategies to help achieve the DMEE team’s goals.

The ideal candidate is energized by thinking about how political dynamics and relationships affect energy policy decisions. Successful applicants must have experience related to political and/or advocacy campaigns, bolstered by exceptional project management, relationship building, and communication skills. While you do not need to be a state energy policy expert to be considered for this role, strong candidates will possess an interest in energy policy issues and be comfortable with communicating with decision-makers regarding United’s state policy priorities. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and flexible. Candidates will need to travel to meet with key stakeholders approximately 1-2 times per quarter.

  • Develop effective communication strategies that incorporate state-specific energy outlooks and political landscapes and deploy those strategies to represent United in front of state decision-makers

A New UK Growth Opportunity within high-performance industrial products

Excelerate360 is a specialist B2B sales outsourcing business helping innovative and technology-led organisations accelerate growth across the UK, Europe and North America.

We work with ambitious scale-ups, established businesses and global brands, providing outsourced business development, inside sales and account management solutions across sectors including SaaS, Cyber Security, FinTech, Digital Transformation and Manufacturing.

We are now launching an exciting new UK sales opportunity and are looking for an experienced Inside Sales Representative to join Excelerate360 and represent one of our established global clients.

Our client is a globally recognised leader in high-performance industrial products and solutions, with a long-standing reputation for technical expertise, innovation and supporting organisations across some of the world's most demanding industries.

As part of their Pathfinder UK growth program, you'll play an important role in identifying and developing new customer opportunities across emerging and high-value sectors, including Aerospace, Defence and other technically demanding industries.

This is a chance to join a new growth programme from the ground up, build a UK pipeline, and have a direct impact on the client's expansion, with performance-based earning potential that reflects the commercial opportunities you help generate.

This is a new-business-focused role where your primary responsibility is to find, qualify and develop new customer opportunities across the UK.

A key part of the role will be identifying the strongest opportunities within emerging and high-value sectors, understanding how these industries buy, who the key decision-makers are, and where the client's technical solutions can add value.

You'll be responsible for opening doors and creating opportunities, identifying potential customers, engaging decision-makers, understanding their requirements and developing genuine sales opportunities.

Once an opportunity is qualified, you'll support the prospect through the product evaluation and trial process, working closely with the client and distributor teams.

As the opportunity progresses, you'll work alongside the client's direct sales and distributor teams to support the conversion and eventual handover. Your strength will be in finding the right customers, creating demand, developing the opportunity and converting new product trials.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, research and qualify new business opportunities across the UK.
  • Research and target organisations within emerging and high-value sectors, identifying relevant applications, buying processes and key decision-makers.
  • Build and manage your own prospect pipeline.
  • Conduct proactive outbound prospecting through cold calling, LinkedIn and other sales channels.
  • Engage with relevant customer decision-makers and influencers.
  • Build strong relationships with prospective customers and understand their requirements.
  • Use your industry knowledge, network and commercial understanding to identify new opportunities and open doors with prospective customers.
  • Identify where the client's products and solutions can add value.
  • Develop qualified opportunities and progress them towards product evaluation or trial.
  • Coordinate and support product trials, working closely with the client, distributor and customer.
  • Remain engaged throughout the trial process, supporting customer queries and helping to progress the opportunity.
  • Ensure converted product trails are effectively transitioned to the appropriate sales or account management team.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and provide regular reporting on pipeline development, customer engagement, trials and opportunity status.
  • Manage your own activity, pipeline and priorities to maximise new business opportunities.
  • Consistently work towards agreed business development and commercial objectives.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a confident, commercially driven sales professional who enjoys finding new business and creating opportunities from scratch.

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience in Inside Sales, Business Development or New Business Sales.
  • Demonstrable experience in cold outreach, lead generation and new business prospecting.
  • Experience within, or selling into, complex or technically demanding sectors such as Aerospace, Defence, Manufacturing, Engineering or similar industries.
  • Strong understanding of industry-specific buying processes, stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders throughout a sales cycle.
  • A proven track record of delivering against business development, pipeline or commercial objectives.
  • Strong telephone presence and confidence engaging with decision-makers.
  • Experience using LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for prospecting.
  • Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot or similar.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent listening, questioning and presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.
  • Ability to identify genuine customer needs and develop commercial opportunities.
  • Strong organisation and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and prioritise workload effectively.
  • Comfortable working independently and under pressure in a performance-driven environment.
  • Good technology aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn CRM and sales engagement applications.

Desirable

  • Degree-level education preferred.

The Person

You'll be a proactive, resilient and commercially minded sales professional who enjoys the challenge of finding new business.

You'll be confident picking up the phone, approaching new prospects and engaging decision-makers. You'll know how to ask the right questions, uncover genuine requirements and build relationships that turn cold prospects into qualified opportunities.

You'll enjoy the hunt, but you'll also understand that successful new-business development is about more than making the first call. It's about developing the relationship, staying close to the opportunity and working collaboratively to move it forward.

You'll be highly organised, target-driven and comfortable taking ownership of your own pipeline and results.

Why Join This New UK Growth Initiative?

This isn't simply another Inside Sales position within an established team.

You'll be joining Excelerate360 at the start of an exciting new client programme, giving you the opportunity to help build the UK pipeline and make a visible commercial impact.

You'll have the opportunity to:

If you're an experienced Inside Sales or Business Development professional who thrives on cold outreach, finding new business and developing opportunities within complex or technically demanding sectors, this is an exciting chance to make your mark on a brand-new UK growth initiative.

jobs.description:
Kevel is transforming the retail media space with its cutting-edge, AI-driven ad tech infrastructure APIs that power the Retail Media Cloud™. This groundbreaking solution combines the power of AI insights with API-based technology, allowing multi-brand retailers to build dynamic, customizable ad platforms while maintaining full control of their first-party data. With Kevel, retailers can deliver personalized shopper experiences, optimize ad targeting, and unlock predictive insights to stay ahead in an ever-evolving market.

JOB OVERVIEW: We are building a new Platform Support Team to serve as the dedicated first line of engineering support for our internal platform and we're looking for a leader to build it from the ground up. This team acts as the primary point of contact for internal engineering squads after customer-facing Technical Support, serving as the engineering escalation point for customer-facing support teams and as first responder for platform alerts.

As the Platform Support & Operations Team Lead, you will define, build, and lead this new function. You'll hire and develop a team of support and operations engineers, establish the processes and standards that make the team effective. Your leadership will help reduce toil across our 70-person engineering organization, enabling smaller, AI-augmented squads to focus on high-impact product and platform work. This is a player-coach role: in the near term you'll be hands-on alongside your team — doing triage, responding to incidents, and building runbooks yourself — while simultaneously establishing the processes and standards that make the function sustainable.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with real ownership: you'll directly improve platform stability and engineer productivity through hands-on operational work. In the near term, the team provides centralized support and operations. Over time, under your leadership, it will become the primary first-tier on-call engineering function for the platform (with domain squads retaining higher-tier on-call for complex issues).

LOCATION: REMOTE - HUNGARY. This position is 100% remote. Applicants located anywhere within Hungary are encouraged to apply. Applicants must be legally eligible to work within Hungary.

PAY TRANSPARENCY: Kevel uses external, third-party market data to determine compensation for all open positions. Our compensation philosophy is based on the candidate’s specific working location and experience level. This means that we will take a no negotiationapproach in our recruitment and offer processes. We believe this is an important step in living our value of embracing diversity while underlining our commitment to fair, equitable and inclusive pay practices.

The pay range for this position is betweenHUF 24,500,000 and HUF 25,680,000. An exact offer for this position will be determined based on the candidate's working location and experience level, in relation to our existing team.

All compensation packages include the additional benefits as described in the 'Why you'll love working with us' section below. We also have a transparent ‘Total Rewards Philosophy’ we’d be happy to share with you which describes our overall approach to compensation and benefits in full detail! Our recruitment team can share more about this with you in an initial phone interview and will be happy to answer any questions you have related to compensation at Kevel!

WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH:

Team Building & Leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and develop an initial team of two Platform Support & Operations Engineers, defining role expectations and career growth paths.
  • Define the team's operating model, priorities, and ways of working, and evolve them as the function matures.
  • Coach and mentor team members on troubleshooting, incident response, and communication skills; conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations.
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence, psychological safety, and sustainable pace — including designing a fair, sustainable on-call rotation.

Support Operations & Process Design

  • Establish and own the team's support and triage processes: intake, prioritization, SLAs, escalation paths, and handoffs with domain squads and customer-facing Technical Support.
  • Define the standards for runbooks, documentation, and knowledge management, ensuring recurring issues are solved once and escalated less often over time.
  • Build the operating rhythm for first-tier on-call, including coverage models, escalation criteria, and post-incident review practices. This includes defining weekend and holiday coverage — in the near term, the team's weekday coverage spans most of the 24-hour day via globally distributed shifts; weekend and holiday coverage will be defined collaboratively with your manager as the team ramps.
  • Personally handle triage, incident response, and runbook development alongside your ICs, especially during the team's early ramp — this is a working lead role, not a coordination-only one.

Incident Management & Reliability

  • Own the incident management function for first-tier response — ensure rapid triage, clear communication during incidents, and high-quality post-mortems that drive real improvements.
  • Define, track, and report on support and reliability metrics (MTTR, escalation volume, trends, root causes) to keep management informed of trends and capacity needs.
  • Lead the hands on work for tuning thresholds, improving alert specificity, and automating known-safe responses so domain engineers are only paged when genuinely needed.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with platform engineering squad leads to surface recurring issues, advocate for preventative fixes, and follow through on resolution.
  • Champion the team's evolution toward proactive, SRE-aligned practices, including automation, self-service tooling, and AI-augmented triage.
  • Gather and synthesize feedback from internal teams to continuously improve platform usability and reliability.

SKILLS YOU'LL BRING WITH YOU:

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, operations, SRE, or platform engineering roles, including 2+ years leading or managing a technical team (formal management or sustained tech lead experience). Comfortable remaining hands-on technically while building the management layer around you.
  • Proven experience building or scaling a support, operations, or SRE function — designing processes, defining metrics, and establishing on-call practices.
  • Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, databases, or similar modern platforms — enough depth to guide triage, review runbooks, and earn credibility with engineers.
  • Experience with incident management practices, including running post-mortems and driving follow-through on action items.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.) and how to use them to make better triage and alert tuning decisions.
  • Clear communicator who can explain operational problems and their impact to engineers and managers alike.
  • A coaching mindset with a track record of developing engineers and building healthy team cultures.

*Important Note: This role participates in a rotating on-call schedule covering both primary and backup coverage outside standard business hours, approximately 2 - 4 days per month. On-call participation is compensated in addition to base salary, in line with applicable local law and Kevel's compensation practices in your country. Specific rates and rotation details are confirmed in your offer and employment contract.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience standing up a brand-new team or function in a high-growth startup or scaling engineering organization.
  • Background spanning both support engineering and operations/SRE.
  • Experience leveraging AI/ML tools for triage, automation, or support workflows — or strong interest in leading a team that does.
  • Experience creating or maintaining internal developer platforms.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, etc.) and CI/CD practices.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US:

  • Fully Remote Team: We are a 100% remote work environment with employees located around the world. You are welcome to work from home, one of our offices, a WeWork office, or an equivalent co-working space.
  • Flexible Working Hours: We understand our employees have their own lives, responsibilities and working preferences. We trust our employees to communicate with their managers, and work when they work best.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - Kevel provides 100% employer paid medical benefits for our employees and their children, plus comprehensive, affordable coverage for all other dependents.
  • Savings opportunity for the Future: Kevel offers retirement savings plans with employer contributions so employees can save toward future financial objectives.
  • Rest and Relaxation: Unlimited personal time off - and we mean it! We trust our employees to take the time they need, whenever they need it. We also offer Paid Holidays + a Kevel Holiday Break (from 12/24 - 1/1 every year!)
  • Kevelfest: Our annual corporate retreat! The entire Kevel team gets together once a year for a four - day in - person event filled with collaboration, team building, celebration and fun!
  • Home Office Stipend: You’ll receive a new windows or mac machine (your choice) + a $500 home office allowance to purchase what you need to set up your work space properly!
  • Parental Leave Support: We support all parents with salary continuation and benefits when our employees are growing their families.

Req ID:383109

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Mainframe Migration Test Architect-REMOTE to join our team in McKinney, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Mainframe Migration Test Architect

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end-to-end testing strategy, planning, governance, and execution for a large-scale z/VSE to z/OS migration program. This role will be responsible for defining the testing approach, ensuring comprehensive coverage across applications, infrastructure, data, security, and operational processes, while providing overall quality and release readiness governance.

The ideal candidate must possess deep Mainframe testing and migration expertise and have prior experience leading testing efforts for Mainframe modernization, platform migration, or legacy transformation programs. A key responsibility of this role is establishing a risk-based testing strategy, ensuring testing effort is aligned to the scope and complexity of changes introduced by the migration rather than applying uniform testing across all components

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Governance

  • Define and own the overall migration testing strategy, framework, and roadmap.
  • Establish testing standards, quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and governance processes.
  • Develop a risk-based testing methodology aligned to migration waves and cutover milestones.
  • Provide executive reporting on testing progress, quality metrics, risks, and release readiness.

Risk-Based Testing & Change Impact Assessment

  • Lead application and infrastructure impact assessments to understand migration-related changes.
  • Establish a risk-ranking model to classify components as High, Medium, or Low Risk based on:
    • Code modifications
    • JCL conversion impacts
    • Data migration changes
    • CICS transaction changes
    • Interface dependencies
    • Security changes
    • Operational and scheduler impacts
    • Business criticality
  • Design testing depth and coverage based on migration risk and business impact.
  • Focus testing effort on areas of highest risk while optimizing effort for unchanged components.
  • Maintain a Testing Risk Register and Migration Testing Heat Map.
  • Identify migration-specific risks and ensure mitigation plans are incorporated into testing activities.

Test Planning & Design

  • Develop comprehensive testing plans covering:
    • System Testing
    • System Integration Testing (SIT)
    • End-to-End Business Process Testing
    • Regression Testing
    • Data Validation & Reconciliation Testing
    • Performance & Volume Testing
    • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
    • Cutover & Rollback Validation Testing
  • Establish traceability between requirements, migration changes, risks, and test cases.

Mainframe & Migration Validation

  • Define testing coverage for:
    • COBOL applications
    • CICS transactions
    • JCL conversion and batch processing
    • VSAM, DB2, and IMS databases
    • File transfers and interfaces
    • Security configurations and access controls
    • Enterprise schedulers
    • Infrastructure and operational procedures
  • Validate functional equivalence and operational readiness of workloads migrated to z/OS.
  • Ensure proper reconciliation of converted data and migrated business processes.

Federated Test Leadership

  • Coordinate testing across:
    • Mainframe Teams
    • Application Teams
    • Infrastructure Teams
    • Security Teams
    • Database Teams
    • Business SMEs
  • Establish testing standards and reusable assets across workstreams.
  • Lead defect triage, prioritization, and remediation activities.
  • Drive issue resolution and dependency management across teams.

Cutover Readiness & Deployment Validation

  • Define cutover rehearsal and mock migration testing strategies.
  • Validate production deployment procedures and rollback capabilities.
  • Ensure all critical business processes are successfully executed during rehearsal events.
  • Provide Go/No-Go recommendations for migration releases.

Preferred Qualifications

Mandatory Mainframe Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Test Architecture, Test Management, or Quality Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Mainframe applications, platforms, and testing methodologies.
  • Experience with:
    • z/VSE
    • z/OS
    • COBOL
    • CICS
    • JCL
    • VSAM
    • DB2 and/or IMS
    • RACF / ACF2 / Top Secret
    • Batch Processing
    • Enterprise Scheduling tools
  • Demonstrated experience leading testing for Mainframe modernization, platform upgrades, rehosting, or z/VSE-to-z/OS migration initiatives.

Risk-Based Testing Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing risk-based testing methodologies within complex transformation programs.
  • Strong ability to conduct migration impact assessments and translate findings into targeted testing strategies.
  • Experience identifying and prioritizing testing scope based on technical, business, operational, and compliance risks.
  • Ability to balance test coverage, quality, and program timelines through intelligent risk management.

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading large, cross-functional testing organizations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams.
  • Exceptional executive communication and governance reporting capabilities.

Deliverables

  • Enterprise Test Strategy
  • Risk-Based Testing Framework
  • Migration Test Plan
  • Test Coverage Matrix
  • Impact Assessment & Risk Heat Map
  • Environment & Test Data Strategy
  • SIT and End-to-End Test Plans
  • Defect Management Process
  • Cutover Rehearsal Plan
  • Go/No-Go Readiness Assessments
  • Executive Quality Dashboards

Basic Qualifications

Minimum 8 years Technical Architecture-Mainframe experience

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. About Us

Simply put, we believe in the power of sleep.

As sleep health champions, we want more and more people to wake up to a brighter day every day. And, we are making daily progress, as we help more organizations see sleep as transformational and a foundational pillar of health. We strive to give more access to the technology and care they need to lead fuller lives.

Our depth of knowledge in the science of sleep gives us a unique perspective on sleep as a critical intervention strategy in chronic disease. We help people see the right problem and the right way forward, elevating not just our solutions but also advancing the field of sleep medicine.

Our vision is to work with our partners — employers, health systems, health plans, government agencies, provider groups and others committed to transforming care — to expand sleep health care to where it is needed, so it can take its rightful place in the healthcare ecosystem.

About the role

The VP/SVP, People reports to the Chief Financial Officer of Nox Health and serves as a strategic People partner to Nox Health executive leadership team. The role has primary responsibility for the People agenda across Nox Health Corporate globally.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership across the full employee lifecycle, ensuring that People strategies, programs, systems, and practices support business growth, organizational effectiveness, scalability, and strong employee experience and engagement.

As a senior People leader, the VP/SVP partners closely with business and executive leaders on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership capability, talent strategy, employee engagement, and organizational change.

The role has significant responsibility for ensuring strong and scalable People Operations across responsibility areas, including compensation and benefits, HR systems, policies, compliance, employee relations, and workforce risk management.

The VP/SVP works in close partnership with the other HR team members leading consistent People frameworks, programs, and practices across Nox Health. Together, the People team ensures aligned consistency across Nox Health while incorporating and tailoring nuanced needs of respective businesses, geographies, and employee populations. The ideal candidate will demonstrate past experience both building and scaling People functions and organizations, with a strong player-coach, roll-up your sleeves mentality.

What you'll do

People Strategy, Business Partnership & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Develop, implement and execute People strategies aligned with Nox Health business priorities, growth plans, and organizational needs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on organizational effectiveness, talent, workforce, leadership, and People matters.
  • Partner with leaders on organizational design, operating models, workforce planning, and current and future capability requirements.
  • Translate business priorities into practical People solutions that strengthen organizational performance and support growth.
  • Lead and support organizational change and significant business transformations, including organizational design, employee communications, engagement surveys and strategies, retention planning, and alignment of People programs and practices.

Talent, Performance & Employee Experience

  • Lead talent and succession planning for critical roles and key talent.
  • Partner with leaders to identify, develop, and retain high-potential and critical talent.
  • Strengthen leadership and manager effectiveness through coaching, talent discussions, and partnership with learning and development resources.

People Operations & HR Systems

  • Provide leadership and oversight of People Operations, ensuring effective, compliant, and scalable operations.
  • Ensure efficient and employee-centered processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, performance processes, and offboarding.
  • Oversee and continuously improve HR systems, workflows, data quality, reporting, and operational controls.
  • Establish, continuously improve, and simplify People policies, processes, and governance, balancing consistency across Nox Health with local business and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure a consistent and high-quality People experience for employees and managers across the organization.

Total Rewards

  • Provide strategic leadership overseeing the global benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, leave programs, and 401(k) retirement plans, ensuring effective administration, regulatory compliance, and a strong employee experience.
  • Oversee relationships with benefits and retirement-plan vendors, brokers, and third-party administrators, including ongoing evaluation of service, cost, compliance, and plan effectiveness.
  • Partner with leadership on compensation decisions, organizational changes, job architecture, and workforce investments.

Employee Relations, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliant employment practices, policies, and controls, with particular expertise and oversight across U.S. federal, state, and local employment requirements, including employee records, leaves, onboarding/offboarding, and related employment processes.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate People-related compliance, employee relations, workforce, and organizational risks.
  • Coach leaders and People team members on broad People practices
  • Partner with internal and external legal counsel, as appropriate, on employment-related matters.

People Analytics & Executive Reporting

  • Use People data and workforce analytics to inform organizational decisions, identify emerging trends, and proactively address workforce risks and opportunities.

  • Provide leadership with meaningful insights and recommendations that support informed business and workforce decisions.
  • Ensure accurate and reliable People data across systems and processes.

People Leadership & Collaboration

  • Build, lead, coach, and develop People team members within the role’s area of responsibility.
  • Foster a People function characterized by strong business partnership, operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across the Nox Health People function to develop shared frameworks, tools, and ways of working.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Labor and Employment Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Strategic Regional Originator – Independent Commercial Partner

Organisation: The CFO HQ
Location: UK-wide, with particular interest in the Midlands, North of England and other strategically important regions
Working arrangement: Remote and regionally focused
Engagement type: Independent commercial partnership
Time commitment: Flexible, typically 5–50 hours per week
Indicative earning potential: £300,000+ per annum, depending on activity, successful introductions and commercial outcomes

About The CFO HQ

The CFO HQ is a specialist finance leadership, transformation, deals, talent and managed-services firm. We support organisations with access to experienced CFOs, finance directors, transformation professionals and specialist advisory capabilities.

Our ambition is to build a distinctive, internationally connected finance advisory platform—combining senior expertise, regional relationships and practical execution to help clients address their most important financial and strategic priorities.

As we expand our presence across the UK, we are appointing a select group of Strategic Regional Originators to help identify opportunities, build senior relationships and extend The CFO HQ's reach within key regional business communities.

The opportunity

This is an entrepreneurial, relationship-led opportunity for an established professional with strong regional networks and the credibility to engage business owners, CEOs, CFOs, investors, professional advisers and other senior decision-makers.

Strategic Regional Originators act as trusted commercial ambassadors for The CFO HQ. You will identify organisations that could benefit from our services, initiate high-quality conversations and connect prospective clients with the appropriate specialists within our team.

This is not a conventional salaried sales position. It is a flexible, independent commercial partnership suited to senior professionals who want to use their experience and networks to create valuable introductions while remaining engaged in other executive, advisory or portfolio activities.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain senior relationships across your regional business community.
  • Identify organisations facing finance leadership, growth, transformation, transaction, talent or compliance challenges.
  • Originate qualified opportunities for The CFO HQ's advisory, fractional CFO, finance transformation, deals, managed services and talent solutions.
  • Introduce prospective clients and strategic partners to the appropriate members of The CFO HQ team.
  • Represent The CFO HQ professionally at relevant business, investment and professional-networking events.
  • Build relationships with accountants, lawyers, banks, investors, private equity firms, corporate-finance advisers and other referral partners.
  • Provide informed regional market intelligence and identify emerging commercial opportunities.
  • Support introductory discussions, propositions and relationship development where appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of introductions, opportunities and agreed next steps.
  • Operate in accordance with The CFO HQ's ethical, confidentiality, data-protection and professional standards.

About you

You are likely to be an experienced:

  • CFO, finance director or senior finance professional;
  • Partner, director or senior adviser within a professional-services firm;
  • Business development, corporate finance or commercial leader;
  • Banker, investor, intermediary or professional-networking specialist;
  • Portfolio executive, consultant, non-executive director or entrepreneur; or
  • Well-connected regional business leader with trusted senior relationships.

What we are looking for

  • A strong and credible network of senior business relationships within your region or specialist market.
  • The confidence to engage business owners, boards, C-suite executives and professional advisers.
  • A consultative, relationship-led approach to originating opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to recognise genuine client needs.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High standards of integrity, discretion and professionalism.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a wider specialist team.
  • An established understanding of regional business dynamics and professional networks.
  • Relevant finance, advisory, investment, legal, banking or commercial experience is advantageous.

What The CFO HQ provides

  • Access to a broad portfolio of CFO, finance, transformation, deals, talent and managed-service capabilities.
  • Support from experienced finance leaders and specialist advisers.
  • A recognised platform through which to develop valuable regional and national relationships.
  • Professional marketing, proposition and business-development materials.
  • Flexible participation that can complement an existing portfolio career or advisory practice.
  • Commercial rewards linked to successful introductions and agreed outcomes.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the growth of a distinctive finance leadership and advisory business.

Important engagement information

This opportunity is offered on an independent, non-exclusive commercial-partnership basis. It does not create an employment relationship, guaranteed working hours or guaranteed income. Any remuneration arrangements, eligibility conditions and payment terms will be documented separately and agreed before appointment.

Applicants should disclose any existing contractual, regulatory, fiduciary or commercial commitments that could create an actual or perceived conflict of interest.

How to apply

Please complete our dedicated Strategic Originator application form:

Please include a summary of your professional background, regional or sector networks, current portfolio commitments and the contribution you believe you could make to The CFO HQ.

Applications submitted through the dedicated form will be reviewed confidentially by our leadership team.

Inclusion

The CFO HQ welcomes applications from experienced professionals of all backgrounds. Appointments are based on relevant experience, professional credibility, commercial alignment and the ability to contribute meaningfully to our clients and regional growth.

Company :

Allegheny Health Network

Job Description :

This is a remote position, but we require candidates to be located in the Eastern Time Zone to align with our Pittsburgh, PA-based operations

GENERAL OVERVIEW:

The incumbent is a key resource responsible for the implementation, execution, and analysis of post-award and financial management activities for grants, contracts, and/or clinical trials within the Sponsored Programs Financial Services (SPFS) supporting Allegheny-Singer Research Institute and Allegheny Health Network. Responsibilities include complex award set-up, comprehensive transaction processing, compliance review, cash management, collections, financial reporting, and project close-out. Possesses deep understanding and ensures material accuracy of financial statements/reports. Independently analyzes complex financial results and outcomes, trends/projections, performance metrics and proactively provides root cause analysis and recommendations to facilitate business decisions while adhering to institutional policies and procedures and Sponsor guidelines. Serves as a mentor to junior analysts.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Project Portfolio Management: Manages a complex portfolio of sponsored programs, providing comprehensive post-award financial oversight from program activation to close-out. Performs advanced analysis on budget performance and account receivables, independently investigates and troubleshoots significant variances, developing corrective action plans. Reviews, approves, and prepares financial transactions in accordance with award/contract/Sponsor terms, GAAP, Uniform Guidance and institutional policies and procedures. Leads financial meetings with constituents on financial performance to enable Investigators/Directors, cost center managers, and business partners to make sound financial decisions in accordance with programmatic needs. Proactively monitors subaward and contracted service agreements in accordance with terms, facilitates complex rebudgeting, no-cost extension requests, costing allocations for personnel, properly documenting complex cost transfers, tracking cost share, and manages complex cost overruns.
  • Compliance Management: Possesses expert understanding of business and financial terms and conditions of grant, contract, and/or clinical trial agreements. Independently maintains compliance with allowable costs, period of performance, subrecipient monitoring, tracking cost share and program income, effort reporting, reporting, other special test provisions, cash management invoicing, and clinical trial billing compliance. Maintains expertise in federal, state, local, private sponsors, and other agency regulations including Uniform Guidance. Independently evaluates and develops business processes in support of post-award management.
  • Invoicing, Accounting Receivable, and Cash Management: Possesses advanced understanding of payment terms and payment schedules as outlined in the grant, contract and/or clinical agreement terms. Ensures prompt invoicing and timely follow-up on outstanding payments owed. Ensures proper recording of cash against programs. Expertly troubleshoot, analyzes, and solves complex payment variances and queries with Sponsor ensuring positive cash flow. Proactively sets up and works within Sponsor portals to setup payment profiles, submit invoices, and retrieve payment backup as needed.
  • Month-end Close: Leads processes and prepares complex journal entries to support the monthly close process and the generation of the monthly financial statements/reports. Ensures all financial transactions/entries are properly documented and completed timely. Guarantees all financial transactions/entries agree with GAAP, Uniform Guidance, and with institutional policies and procedures. Serves as a subject matter expert with the institution's financial systems.
  • Reporting: Independently prepares and analyzes complex financial reports, working collaboratively with management, financial and program staff to address discrepancies and correct errors. Proactively monitors and meets all internal and Sponsor stipulated deadlines and content requirements. Guarantees reports are clear, accurate, and submitted on-time. Translates and accurately reports financials on Sponsor required forms as required. Creates and presents ad hoc reports and analyses.
  • Project Setup: Independently sets up new projects in financial systems for all types of projects including cost reimbursement, fixed price, milestone-based, and other types including cost share. Expertly navigates sponsor guidelines, award documents, and institutional policy to establish a strong basis for ongoing award management. Expertly navigates the institution's financial systems.
  • Project Closeout: Independently completes complex project closeout documentation that are accurate, properly documented and on time. Guarantees cost share requirements have been met, unallowable costs have been removed, subaward/contract expenses are accounted for, and outstanding obligations have been addressed. Communicates effectively with financial and program staff and others as appropriate to gather necessary information and supporting documentation. Guarantees all invoices and payments are complete. Closes project cost center in all financial systems.
  • Audit: Independently applies compliance with regulations and guidelines and implements/documents internal controls, policies, and procedures. Leads the gathering of documentation and information for auditors from multiple sources as required.
  • Mentorship: Mentors and trains junior Business Analysts on best practices, complex processes, and problem-solving techniques.
  • Policy and Procedure Development: Contributes to policy and procedure development. Develops and offers enhancements to procedures and business forms.
  • Process Improvement: Identifies opportunities for process improvement within SPFS and actively participates in implementation.
  • Other duties as assigned or requested.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field or relevant experience and/or education as determined by the company in lieu of bachelor's degree.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles, budget planning, and financial analysis with the ability to interpret and apply fiscal regulations (preferred with focus on clinical research or healthcare)
  • Prior experience in grant, contract and clinical trial financial administration, knowledge of federal agency regulations, policies, and procedures, Uniform Guidance, laws and federal acquisition regulations applicable to research and sponsored programs
  • Demonstrated ability to assess, research, and resolve complex financial and compliance issues while applying sound judgment.
  • 5+ years of experience in relevant finance or accounting roles.
  • This position requires a deep understanding of financial management in a clinical trials setting, expertise in research accounting, and a strong background in compliance and auditing

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field.
  • Prior experience with clinical trial financial management and/or clinical research billing compliance and regulations

SKILLS:

  • Exceptional organizational and mathematical skills with ability to analyze data, formulate conclusions, demonstrate agility and problem-solving techniques.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability lead financial meetings with all levels within the organization and with ability to translate and summarize numbers into an understandable narrative to others.
  • Strong attention to detail with high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize and manage large volumes of work to anticipate and meet tight deadlines.
  • Advanced proficiency in financial software and adaptability to new technologies. Expert understanding of financial processes and controls including reconciliations.
  • Advanced proficiency with MS Excel skills such as sorting, pivot tables, filtering, vlookups, subtotals, basic formulas.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and implement complex regulations, procedures and/or compliance standards.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Experience mentoring junior staff.
  • Excellent communication skills, ability to translate and summarize numbers into an understandable narrative to others.
  • Advanced organizational skills with ability to analyze data, formulate conclusions, demonstrate problem-solving skills.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Title:

CRM Architect

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior D365 CRM Architect to lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE (Customer Engagement) solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Dynamics 365 CRM modules, Power Platform, and Azure integration, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade CRM solutions that align with strategic business goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead architect for D365 CRM implementations, upgrades, and integrations
  • Design scalable, secure, and performance-optimized D365 CE solutions across Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service modules.
  • Translate complex business requirements into robust architectural designs and solution blueprints.
  • Oversee solution configuration, customizations (including plugins, workflows, Power Automate), and data migrations.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to delivery teams including developers, consultants, and testers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, business units, and external vendors.
  • Drive governance around D365 customizations and Power Platform components.
  • Ensure adherence to Microsoft best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Lead performance tuning, code reviews, and quality assurance efforts.
  • Stay current on D365 roadmap and recommend new capabilities where appropriate.
  • Working with leadership to budget a project
  • Pre-sales experience (ideally if we can find someone with some that would be ideal, but willing to upskill and train if have the acumen).

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM / D365 CE, including multiple full-cycle implementations.
  • Strong understanding of Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
  • Expertise in data modeling, integrations (Azure Logic Apps, APIs), and security models in D365.
  • Hands-on experience with Dynamics SDK, JavaScript, C#, and custom plugin development.
  • Experience with CI/CD for D365 using Azure DevOps.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience integrating with ERP systems (e.g., Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations).
  • Knowledge of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Omnichannel, or Voice of the Customer.
  • Background in industries such as finance, healthcare, or public sector is a plus.

Salary Range:

The base salary range for this position is $95,720- $150,417 CAD, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is: 8/24. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

jobs.excerpt: Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! jobs.description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.


Position Overview

As a Senior Platform Engineer, your primary mandate is to manage our platforms to improve business continuity, best practices and contribute to the developer experience end-to-end, eliminating friction, accelerating onboarding to first contribution, and lifting productivity across the entire software delivery lifecycle. You will drive modernization and platform initiatives and steward high-leverage practices (Engineering, DevEx, SRE, DevSecOps, and AI-assisted engineering), operating both hands-on and strategically while partnering with executive leadership and guiding Staff/Senior engineers to deliver scalable, reliable, compliant, and cost-efficient solutions on AWS. Crucially, you will translate day-to-day developer needs into Golden Paths, opinionated tooling, and policy-backed workflows, enabling adoption through clear documentation, targeted training, and automated self-service capabilities.

Key Responsabilities

  • Architectural Strategy: Define and steer medium and long-term architectural strategies for the platform, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and reliability across all AWS environments.
  • Platform as a Product: Codify architecture into practice by delivering reference implementations and Golden Path templates for high-performance builds and standardized scaffolding.
  • GitOps & Continuous Delivery: Engineer safe delivery and reusable GitHub Actions. Institutionalize GitOps using ArgoCD/Flux and Flagger for progressive rollouts (canary/blue-green) with automated, SLO-gated rollbacks.
  • Cloud-Native Orchestration: Manage and optimize Kubernetes operations using Karpenter for intelligent node provisioning, as well as HPA and KEDA for event-driven autoscaling.
  • Observability & SRE: Make observability the default through OpenTelemetry and New Relic. Define SLIs/SLOs, establish error-budget policies, and automate tracking of post-incident actions.
  • Security & Service Mesh: Raise cloud and service security, operate and propose improvements related to OAuth2/JWT and secrets lifecycle management (Secrets Manager/KMS). Implement Policy-as-Code adoption across CI/CD and Kubernetes admission controllers.
  • Event-Driven Excellence: Design and operate event topologies covering Kafka partitioning, compaction, retention policies, and schema evolution, including performance and reliability.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Promote the adoption of AI-assisted practices to enhance code quality, automated refactoring, automated operations, and technical documentation.
  • FinOps & Efficiency: Drive cost-aware architecture through cloud computing best practices, scalability, and platform/service efficiency, not merely focusing on savings plans or reservations.
  • Technical Governance: Implement governance and controls that ensure the correct management of services, security, and compliance of our platforms and technologies, contributing to a culture of excellence.

Requirements

Software Engineering & Architecture

- Academic Foundation: Background in Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.

- Expert Development: Extensive hands-on experience in software engineering, with solid proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/Python.

- Distributed Systems: Mastery of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and microservices architecture, designing for high performance and high availability.

- Build: Deep knowledge of Bazel build systems.

Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS Expertise)

- Expert-Level AWS: Deep, practical experience with core services: EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, Networking, and Security.

- Infrastructure as Code: Advanced experience with Terraform (modules/policy enforcement) and Pulumi (multi-language stacks).

- Kubernetes Internals: Deep knowledge of EKS, including Karpenter for scaling, Istio for service mesh, and Argo/Flux for GitOps.

Security, Reliability & Observability

- SRE & Resilience: Mastery of reliability patterns (circuit breakers, retries, back-pressure, stress tests, application architecture) and SLO-driven operations.

- Security Hardening: Expert knowledge of AWS security controls, OPA/Rego policy design for admission controllers, and container security (image signing, ECR scanning).

- Full-Stack Observability: Proficiency in OpenTelemetry design and integration with New Relic, Grafana, and Prometheus.

Developer Experience (DevEx)

- Self-Service Platforms: Proven experience building Internal Developer Portals and ephemeral environments.

- Delivery Automation: Expertise in GitHub Actions, Flagger for progressive delivery, and feature-flag governance.

Soft Skills

- Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex business goals into long-term technical direction.

- Influential Leadership: Excellent communication skills to influence stakeholders and mentor technical leaders.

- Autonomy & Accountability: High degree of ownership with a bias for action in fast-paced, large-scale environments.

- Constructive Culture: Active contributor to feedback loops, ADR/RFC hygiene, and continuous learning.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

- Real-world experience in critical workloads and regulated environments (ideally Fintech).

- Ability to translate compliance controls (PCI-DSS, LGPD) into automated technical patterns.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the Use of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

jobs.description:
Rejoignez nesto – fière lauréate du titre Canadian Rocketship 2025. Propulsée au palmarès Deloitte Fast 50, nesto évolue aux côtés des plus grands innovateurs technologiques du Canada. Nous transformons une industrie hypothécaire de 2,1 billions de dollars à la vitesse de l'éclair en bâtissant l'écosystème hypothécaire du futur.

BÂTISSEZ des technologies de prêt avec les meilleurs développeurs, ingénieurs en IA et experts hypothécaires au pays. Évoluez au sein d'une pile technologique moderne et d'un cadre de développement conçu pour libérer votre plein potentiel et accélérer votre carrière.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Hypercroissance : Classée au palmarès Deloitte Fast 50 pour une 3e année consécutive.
  • Crédibilité Tech : Nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025 par TechTO.
  • Leader de l'industrie : Élue Lending Company of the Year (CLA) pour une 4e année consécutive.
  • Aimant à talents : Lauréat CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025.
  • Technologie de confiance : Propulse les plus grandes institutions financières au Canada.
  • Culture entrepreneuriale : Fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, l'ambition audacieuse et une obsession sans faille pour nos clients.

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un.e directeur.trice de la cyberdéfense pour diriger notre équipe des opérations de sécurité et poursuivre le développement de notre pratique de cyberdéfense. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership concret pour une personne capable d'instaurer l'excellence opérationnelle en matière de détection et de réponse, tout en élevant la maturité de notre programme de sécurité grâce à des tests proactifs, une gestion des risques et une collaboration transversale.

Vos responsabilités au quotidien :

  • Mentorat et développement d'une équipe de professionnels de la sécurité, définition des parcours de carrière et des plans de développement des compétences, et promotion d'une culture d'excellence, de curiosité et d'amélioration continue.
  • Prise en charge de l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la réponse aux incidents : tri, évaluation de la portée, confinement, éradication, rétablissement et amélioration post-incident.
  • Intervention en tant que point d'escalade technique et opérationnel principal lors d'incidents de haute sévérité, en partenariat avec les équipes Juridique, Confidentialité et Fraude.
  • Responsabilité de l'ingénierie de détection, conversion des observations d'incidents en détections à plus haute fidélité, optimisation et automatisation de la réponse.
  • Gestion de la gouvernance des sources de journaux (logs) : couverture télémétrique sur nos systèmes, examens périodiques au rythme des évolutions de l'environnement et des partenaires, et gestion du volume de journaux par rapport à leur valeur de détection.
  • Maintien de la détection et de la réponse à vitesse machine au fur et à mesure que nesto adopte l'IA, sous deux angles : nos propres cycles et les agents eux-mêmes.
  • Impulsion de l'amélioration continue des guides d'intervention (playbooks), de l'enrichissement des données et de l'orchestration afin d'accroître la vitesse et la cohérence des réponses.
  • Promotion d'une approche Purple Team combinant collaboration offensive et défensive : analyse de la surface d'attaque, modélisation des menaces et simulation d'attaques pour identifier et combler les lacunes, nourries par la traque des menaces (threat hunting) et les renseignements opérationnels.
  • Prise en charge de la gestion des expositions et des vulnérabilités, en priorisant selon la criticité des actifs et leur exploitabilité, et en assurant le suivi des correctifs avec les propriétaires de systèmes.
  • Gestion de la stratégie, du choix, du déploiement et du maintien opérationnel des outils de sécurité centraux (notamment EDR et SIEM), en veillant à leur optimisation, leur intégration et la production de renseignements exploitables pour l'équipe.
  • Participation active au comité de gestion des risques, en traduisant les priorités de risque d'affaires en stratégies de défense concrètes.

Votre profil :

  • Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité, incluant la gestion d'équipe en réponse aux incidents, opérations de sécurité, investigation des menaces ou criminalistique numérique (digital forensics).
  • Succès démontré dans la création, la direction et la maturation d'une fonction d'opérations de sécurité, incluant la mise en place de nouvelles capacités.
  • Expérience avérée à la tête d'une équipe d'opérations de sécurité, Blue Team ou réponse aux incidents, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé ou du secteur financier.
  • Expertise approfondie en réponse aux incidents, criminalistique numérique, plateformes EDR et SIEM, modélisation des menaces et gestion de la surface d'attaque.
  • Expérience dans la sélection et la gestion de prestataires SOC / MSSP, incluant la négociation de contrats et la gouvernance continue de la performance.
  • Expérience avec les méthodologies Purple Team ou de tests d'attaque/défense.
  • Solide feuille de route en matière d'engagement auprès de la direction et de contribution aux programmes de gestion des risques de l'entreprise.
  • Excellentes compétences en leadership, en communication et en consolidation d'équipe.

Atouts :

  • Certifications pertinentes (telles que GCIH, GCFA, OSCP ou CISSP).
  • Maîtrise des enjeux de sécurité liés à l'IA : autant le comportement des attaquants tirant parti de l'IA que les flux de travail défensifs accélérés par l'IA.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d'un prestataire MSSP.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

Engagement:6-month contract, full-time, extension subject to project needs

Setup: remote, with required working-hours overlap with the Riga-based team

Start:September 2026 (target onboarding: mid-September)

Team:Finance Data, reporting to Finance Data Engineering Manager

Purpose:Own and deliver the year-end financial audit data workstream for Printful and Printify (September 2026 - March 2027) - a high-autonomy role with structured onboarding, then independent ownership of deliverables with review-level support from the team

About the role:

FYUL is preparing for an interim audit in October 2026 and the main year-end audit in March 2027, covering the Printful and Printify platforms. The Finance Data team owns transactional data ingestion, Snowflake transformations, reconciliation deliverables for Accounting, and Looker reporting. This role takes ownership of the audit data workstream after a short, structured ramp-up, working against externally fixed deadlines with direct mentoring from the hiring manager during onboarding.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Own and deliver reconciliation deliverables for Accounting: wallet balance reconciliations, duplicate and missing transaction detection, ERP vs. data warehouse cross-checks by merchant and currency

  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies surfaced by Accounting and external auditors, with documented root causes and traceable corrections

  • Build and extend Snowflake transformations supporting audit deliverables and corrections in the revenue data warehouse

  • Extend Looker models enabling Accounting self-service: merchant-level data extraction, reconciliation views, duplicate detection

  • Work directly with Accounting stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver audit-ready outputs on fixed deadlines

  • Document all delivered pipelines, corrections, and edge cases throughout the engagement

Your qualifications:

  • 4+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering - or 3+ years with strong hands-on experience in financial or transactional data

  • Production experience with Snowflake or an equivalent cloud data warehouse, and advanced SQL

  • Hands-on experience with financial or transactional datasets: reconciliations, ledger-style data, revenue, payments, or billing

  • Track record of independent delivery after onboarding - this engagement has externally fixed deadlines

ARTIFEX est un bureau d'ingénierie et de conseil en environnement, créé en janvier 1983 et basé à Albi dans le Tarn. L'entreprise compte aujourd'hui plus de 130 collaborateurs répartis sur 6 implantations en France.

ARTIFEX fait partie du groupe SOCOTEC depuis 2024. Nous combinons désormais l'agilité et l'expertise locale qui ont fondé notre développement, avec la solidité et le rayonnement d'un leader de la certification et du contrôle. Cette alliance stratégique renforce notre capacité à répondre aux projets les plus ambitieux tout en conservant notre approche personnalisée et notre connaissance approfondie du territoire, dans un contexte où les enjeux environnementaux et la conformité réglementaire sont de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques.

En tant que Chargé(e) d'affaires étude et conseil, vos missions seront les suivantes :

  • Expertises écologiques : inventaires d'espèces végétales, inventaires d'habitats naturels, recherches bibliographiques et rédaction de comptes rendus d'observation de terrain ;
  • Elaboration de dossiers réglementaires (Volet Naturel d'Etude d'Impact, dérogation espèces protégées, évaluation d'incidence Natura 2000, dossiers d'autorisation environnementale, …) et dans ce cadre :
    • Analyse, description et rédaction d'états initiaux et d'impacts de projets sur les milieux naturels et espèces ;
    • Définition et dimensionnement de mesures pour éviter, réduire ou compenser les impacts (démarche ERC) ;
    • Conseil et Accompagnement du maître d'ouvrage dans sa relation avec les services instructeurs.
  • Suivis écologiques de chantier (efficacité et respect des mesures visant la biodiversité) ou de mesures compensatoires.

Vous recevez dès le début un parcours de formation afin de vous faire monter en compétences et vous permettre de prendre en main les outils et méthodologies de travail. Vous travaillez en équipe sur les projets, avec les autres membres du pôle Biodiversité mais également les experts du pôle Environnement, Paysage, Agricole…

Nous faisons participer tout le monde à la vie de l’entreprise. Aussi vous pourrez prendre des responsabilités transverses pour faire progresser les outils méthodologiques du pôle et les trames, développer les missions et les expertises, devenir tutrice ou tuteur de nouveaux arrivants, devenir référente ou référent au sein de l’entreprise d’une thématique ou d’un outil.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac + 3 ou 5 / Environnement, Écologie et vous possédez une expérience en bureau d'études environnementales ou autres structures associatives en lien avec les compétences demandées.

Vous savez caractériser les habitats avec la codification EUNIS/Corine BIOTOPE et identifier les espèces végétales. Vous connaissez l’écologie des espèces végétales identifiées et savez apprécier son enjeu de conservation.

Vous avez un goût prononcé pour le travail de terrain et de bonnes notions d’écologie générale. Vous savez utiliser un logiciel SIG, et vous êtes à l'aise en Word.

Vous êtes organisé(e), travaillez avec soin, et savez évoluer en équipe avec ce que cela demande de communication et de solidarité.

  • Nous vous accompagnons dans votre carrière en encourageant la promotion interne : chez SOCOTEC, 75% des postes d’encadrement sont pourvus par des promotions internes.
  • Parce que vous nous apportez votre expertise, nous vous aidons à la faire grandir et contribuons activement à votre développement professionnel grâce à des dispositifs de formation enrichis
  • Nous avons d'autres avantages (intéressement, CSE)
  • Avec ses 150 agences en France, SOCOTEC offre des opportunités de mobilité géographique.

Notre processus de recrutement et d’intégration a été optimisé pour offrir une expérience simple, digitale et complète à chaque candidat.

Engagé en faveur de l'égalité des chances, SOCOTEC France vous informe que ce poste est ouvert, à compétences égales, aux candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap.

Let’s SOCOTEC !

SOCOTEC est dans le Top 10 des Best Workplaces® 2025 (catégorie >2500 salariés) !

Rejoindre SOCOTEC, c’est rejoindre une communauté d’experts soudés, une entreprise en croissance qui va de l’avant et qui valorise l’humain et le développement de ses équipes, c’est aussi rejoindre une dynamique collective qui fait la différence sur ses marchés : construction, immobilier, infrastructures, industrie, environnement.

Leader de la durabilité du bâti et des infrastructures depuis plus de 70 ans, nous attachons de l’importance au service clients pour les aider dans la gestion des risques de la conformité jusqu’à la performance en passant par la sécurité des constructions et équipements.

Cette année, SOCOTEC recrute 1500 nouveaux collaborateurs.

Rejoignez-nous et partager un métier au service d’une vision positive : inventer ensemble la ville de demain, plus sûre, durable et inclusive.

Remote Licensed Therapist (LCSW) – Contract – PA and NJ

Position Type:Contract

Pay:$70 to $85 Per hour

Schedule:Around 20 hours a week, although those hours are subject to change based on patient volume
Duration:6+ months
Location:100% remote / work from home
Must have active Pennsylvania and New JerseyLCSW license required andmust be able to bill Medicare

MASC Medical is hiring a contract, fully remote therapist licensed in Pennsylvania and New Jersey on behalf of our client — a fast-growing, virtual-first behavioral health organization. You'll provide telehealth therapy to adults with serious mental illness (SMI), substance use disorders, and dementia — including older adults — as part of a multidisciplinary care team of psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, community health workers, and medical assistants delivering wrap-around outpatient care that keeps patients out of the hospital.

What you'll do

  • Provide virtual psychosocial assessments and individual psychotherapy through a telehealth platform (audio-only sessions as backup when patients can't access video)

  • Deliver time-framed, goal-focused, skill-based therapy using evidence-based approaches: CBT, solution-focused therapy, motivational interviewing, and behavioral activation

  • Lead and facilitate group therapy and support groups

  • Provide support and advocacy to caregivers and family members of patients with dementia and SMI

  • Document treatment response and monitor clinical symptoms in the EMR

  • Collaborate in daily team huddles; identify social determinants of health needs the care team will work to resolve

What you'll need

  • Active, unrestrictedPennsylvania and New Jersey LCSWlicense

  • Must be able to bill Medicare

  • Experience conducting psychotherapy via telehealth

  • Experience screening, assessing, and treatment-planning for common mental health and/or substance use disorders

  • Working knowledge of evidence-based brief behavioral interventions (motivational interviewing, problem-solving treatment, behavioral activation)

  • A confidential home workspace and reliable internet (computer provided)

Pay & benefits

  • $70 to $85 Per hour

  • Weekly payroll and direct deposit

  • Malpractice insurance covered

  • Company-provided computer and equipment

Position Overview

As a Distinguished Engineer, you will serve as a hands-on technical leader driving the next generation of Product Access capabilities, including entitlements, licensing, and access enforcement across cloud and AI-powered products.

You will define and help execute the long-term technical vision for Product Access platforms across Autodesk’s product ecosystem, enabling scalable and intelligent access to capabilities for both human and non-human actors, including services, automations, and AI agents.

This role combines deep technical expertise with the ability to influence engineering direction through implementation, mentorship, innovation, and company-wide technical leadership. You will play a critical role in accelerating strategic initiatives, incubating greenfield capabilities, and modernizing engineering practices through AI-assisted software development workflows.

You will operate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, influence platform adoption, and help teams converge on scalable Product Access solutions that serve long-term company goals. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to influence without direct authority, and a pragmatic approach to balancing local team needs with broader platform and business priorities.

This role is expected to drive outcomes with impact across multiple product organizations and strategic company initiatives.

This role is ideal for a deeply technical leader who wants to combine hands-on engineering, platform innovation, and AI-driven development practices to shape the future of how products are built and accessed.

You will help define both the Product Access platform capabilities and the engineering practices that enable the next generation of cloud and AI-powered experiences—while influencing technical direction and engineering strategy across the company at enterprise scale.

  • Deep expertise in:

  • Demonstrated ability to shape engineering direction through technical vision, innovation, and influence

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational and technical tradeoffs

  • Strong product and business acumen, with the ability to align technical decisions with customer and business outcomes
