  • Remote work opportunity with exposure to international SAP career markets.
  • Competitive compensation based on relevant experience and agreed performance expectations.
  • Training on SAP program offerings, candidate qualification, consultation standards, and internal processes.
  • Professional-development opportunities in educational sales, SAP career pathways, and international lead management.

Requirements

Please submit your updated resume at and a brief note outlining your experience in educational sales, outbound calling, lead conversion, CRM management, and North American customer support. Shortlisted candidates will undergo an initial screening followed by an interview

Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world.

As an Injury Adjuster, you’ll play a critical role in enforcing the fundamental fairness on which our company was founded. You’ll be asked to push the boundaries of what’s required and to think critically as to what our customers want and how that best aligns with our product. Our goal is to leverage technology, data, and a team of highly talented people to build a claims experience that is recognized as number one in the industry.

Root is a “work where it works best” company. This means we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US.

  • Delivers an industry-leading claim experience for all policyholders and claimants
  • Confirms coverage and determines liability for a wide range of accident scenarios
  • Consistently makes prompt and courteous contact with every party involved in a claim
  • Maintains and updates a diary/schedule for each claim in the adjuster's pending
  • Responds to claim correspondence in a timely fashion with very high quality
  • Obtains detailed accident descriptions from drivers, passengers and witnesses
  • Coordinates the repair of damaged vehicles, and assists with rental reimbursement
  • Sets and maintains a loss reserve for every claim in the adjuster's pending
  • Evaluates and settles injury claims from soft tissue to fatalities, including attorney-represented claims
  • Provides input for continuous development of claims guidelines and best practices
  • Recommends potential product developments and process improvements
  • Interacts and communicates effectively with customers, peers, vendors and managers
  • Engages in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current guidelines in claims function, and policy changes and modifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2+ years of successful experience handling personal auto insurance claims across multiple states where the applicant was directly responsible for coverage decisions, liability determinations, issuing payments, taking recorded statements, responding to correspondence, requesting authority from supervisor(s), and negotiating settlement of third-party bodily injury claims across multiple states
  • Demonstrated high quality claim handling balanced with strong productivity
  • Strong technical understanding of liability and casualty principles
  • Aptitude to quickly learn and apply new concepts
  • Coachable and committed to professional growth
  • Experience managing complex personal auto claims through closure
  • Viewed as a resource within team and functional area
  • High sense of professionalism while remaining empathetic
  • Familiarity with claims best practices required
  • Curious in nature

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Kafka Developer builds and operates the event streaming that connects Team Caliber — the NBA platform's business rules engine, built in Java and Drools — to the rest of the decisioning system.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Kafka Developer builds and operates the event streaming that connects Team Caliber — the NBA platform's business rules engine, built in Java and Drools — to the rest of the decisioning system. You design and own the Kafka topics, producers, and consumers that move eligibility, suppression, and decisioning events through the platform reliably and in order. This is a hands-on backend role for an engineer who is fluent in event-driven design and enjoys making high-throughput, fault-tolerant streaming systems work correctly under real production load.

Key Responsibilities

  • Event streaming — Design, build, and own Kafka producers, consumers, and topic strategy that carry rules-engine inputs and outputs across the platform.
  • Rules engine integration — Integrate the Java/Drools rules engine with upstream and downstream systems through well-designed event and API contracts.
  • Reliability — Engineer for correctness under load: partitioning, ordering, idempotency, exactly-once or effectively-once semantics, retries, and dead-letter handling.
  • Backend services — Build and maintain the Java services around the rules engine that produce and consume events and expose APIs.
  • Performance and scale — Profile and tune streaming throughput and latency; ensure the pipeline scales as event volume grows.
  • Observability — Instrument streams and services with logging, metrics, and alerting so issues are caught early and diagnosed quickly.
  • Quality — Write tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards; the platform handles member PHI, so security and compliance hygiene are essential.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related degree
  • 5+ years of backend software engineering, with hands-on production experience building on Apache Kafka/Confluent.
  • Strong Java skills and experience designing event-driven services.
  • Deep understanding of Kafka internals: partitioning, consumer groups, offsets, ordering, and delivery semantics.
  • Solid grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals — idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure handling in asynchronous systems.
  • Experience operating services on cloud infrastructure (Azure or equivalent) with containers/Kubernetes and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator who can define and defend an event contract with partner teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Drools rules engine or another business rules management system.
  • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, schema registry, and Avro/Protobuf.
  • Experience with stream processing patterns and real-time data pipelines.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling requirements.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. jobs.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Who We Are

At Trility Consulting®, we’ve built a strong, remote-work culture where people thrive, grow, and support each other – earning us Great Place to Work® Certification. What You Bring

jobs.description:
At Mindera, we don’t just "write code."

We build products we are proud of, with people we love. Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do. We partner with our clients to deliver high-performance, resilient, and scalable systems that impact users and businesses worldwide.

We are a collection of individuals with different stories, but one shared goal: to build a place where we actually want to work. We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role & The Challenge

We are looking for seasoned Senior .NET Developers who thrive in complex engineering environments, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and take ownership of the software they build.

Reliability and quality are fundamental to our platform, so we're seeking product-minded engineers with proven experience in cloud-native distributed systems and a strong sense of ownership throughout the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you'll be expected to contribute to architectural decisions, clearly articulate the trade-offs behind your technical choices, and take features from business refinement through implementation, deployment, and production monitoring. You'll work with modern engineering practices to build decoupled, maintainable systems that scale reliably in production.

Your role goes beyond writing C# code. You are expected to own the delivery pipeline end to end:

  • Refinement: Challenge ambiguous business requirements, analyze acceptance criteria, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Architecture: Design decoupled, scalable solutions using Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) patterns.
  • Execution: Write highly concurrent, thread-safe applications using .NET 8 or later, with a strong preference for composition over inheritance.
  • Verification: Treat Test-Driven Development (TDD) as an essential engineering practice by writing robust unit and integration tests using xUnit and WireMock to prevent regressions.
  • Delivery & Operations: Deploy through modern CI/CD pipelines and proactively monitor production telemetry using tools such as AWS CloudWatch, New Relic, and GitHub Actions to ensure rapid troubleshooting and operational excellence.

The Tech Stack

  • Core: C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core
  • Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Distributed Systems
  • Cloud & Messaging: AWS (ECS, EC2, SQS, SNS, S3)
  • Databases & Caching: SQL, NoSQL, Redis, Valkey, DynamoDB
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, TeamCity
  • Quality Assurance: xUnit, WireMock, SpecFlow

Requirements

You’ll be a Great Fit If...

  • Engineering Seniority: Solid experience designing and deploying complex, high-throughput backend systems using .NET.
  • Cloud-Native Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, particularly containerized workloads (ECS/EC2) and messaging services (SQS/SNS).
  • System Design Mastery: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection lifetimes, and the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline.
  • Concurrency Discipline: Expert knowledge of asynchronous programming in C#. You understand how the thread pool works and why synchronous blocking (for example, using `.Result` or `.Wait()`) can severely impact the scalability and reliability of web APIs.
  • API Design: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, idempotent operations, and global exception-handling strategies.
  • Communication: Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

It’s a Total Bonus If...

  • Production experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or RabbitMQ.
  • Strong understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs and Generative AI using .NET or Python, particularly for AI-assisted engineering workflows and SDLC automation.

Benefits

The Things We Really Care About:

  • Health Insurance, because health comes first
  • Flexible working hours
  • Open holidays, take the time you need for yourself
  • Profit distribution for everyone
  • Mindera Annual Trip, Sports, and sharing groups to connect and have fun!
  • Training & conferences, create your own training plan

Other Good Things :

  • Choose Laptop & Peripherals that best suit your needs
  • Hotspot with unlimited usage, for work or Netflix ;)
  • Remote culture: We have an office in Casablanca, but Minders work remotely from all over Morocco.
  • At the offices, we have a wide range of snacks to keep you fed and healthy and Partnerships with local businesses

Culture

Most of all you get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together in a politics-free environment. Our culture reflects our lean and self-organization attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication. Freedom and Responsibility go hand in hand, and we value commitment, feedback, and empathy.

About Mindera

At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera.

We partner with our clients, to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient and scalable software systems that create an impact in their users and businesses across the world.

You get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together.

Our culture reflects our lean and self management attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication.

We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.

jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

Position

jobs.title: Design Systems Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

The Opportunity

  • Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for Imprint's design system, balancing immediate product needs with long-term platform investments

  • Partner deeply with Product Design, Engineering, Product Management, and AI teams to ensure system components are scalable, maintainable, production-ready, and aligned to shared priorities

  • Establish governance, contribution models, and decision-making frameworks that give product teams a shared source of truth and let them move faster without sacrificing quality or consistency

  • Evolve the design system beyond traditional Figma libraries and Storybook documentation toward machine-readable, AI-consumable foundations that connect design tooling, code generation, and AI-assisted development

  • Mentor a small team of design systems designers and partner with developers, raising the bar on systems thinking, prioritization, and ownership across the group

  • Stay hands-on by contributing directly to component architecture, documentation, patterns, and guidelines, and by leading complex initiatives from strategy through execution

Your Profile

Required

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including significant design systems ownership and experience leading or managing design systems teams

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling design systems used across multiple product teams in a production environment

  • Deep understanding of component architecture, design tokens, accessibility standards, and design-to-development workflows

  • Strong product judgment with the ability to prioritize high-impact work and make tradeoffs between near-term product needs and long-term system investments

  • Experience partnering closely with frontend engineers and engineering leadership to ship system components that are actually adopted and trusted

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where you own both the strategy and the execution, and where the system needs to evolve continuously

  • Excellent ability to communicate and influence across functions, including educating and advocating for design systems with teams that haven't worked with one before

Nice to Have

  • Experience with modern frontend technologies, component-based development, Storybook, and design token infrastructure

  • Experience with AI-assisted design, code generation, or agent-driven workflows, particularly in exploring how AI transforms the way products are designed and built

  • Background in design engineering or highly technical product environments where the line between design and development is intentionally blurred

  • Experience building design systems in high-growth startup environments where the system had to scale alongside rapid product expansion

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $190K - $250K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (TypeScript/Node.js)
jobs.excerpt: About UtorgFounded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards.
jobs.description:
About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

Location: Remote

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, NATS JetStream, Redis, Jest, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform.

Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

What you’ll do:
  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.
Who you are:
  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.
What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of production experience in backend development with Type Script/Node.js as the primary stack.
  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise — schema design, indexing (partial, GIN/GiST), query optimization, migrations with zero-downtime, database-per-service pattern.
  • Hands-on microservices experience — not a monolith split into modules. You’ve dealt with inter-service communication (RPC + pub/sub), message brokers, idempotency, eventual consistency, saga/outbox patterns.
  • System design experience — decomposing services, designing API contracts, data flow architecture, capacity planning. You can whiteboard a system and explain why you made each decision.
  • Complex integration experience — you’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs, payment systems, or similar external services in production. You know how to handle retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.
  • Production blockchain experience (MUST-HAVE) — you’ve worked with on-chain transactions, multiple networks, and real user funds. You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.
  • Strong testing discipline — unit tests (Jest), integration tests with real databases, microservice testing.
  • Security-conscious — in fintech and crypto, every code path can touch real user funds. You build accordingly.
  • Skilled in technical research — evaluating trade-offs, testing hypotheses, and making data-driven architectural decisions.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate. Fluent in the Russian language.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with NATS JetStream as a transport layer (streams, consumers, delivery policies).
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (pino), distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes beyond basics: Kustomize/Helm, deployment strategies, resource management.
  • Fintech domain knowledge: PCI DSS, GDPR, KYC/AML, payment systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior/middle developers.
  • React basics for back-office UIs (functional components, hooks, Redux, Material-UI).

Interaction with other teams:

Close collaboration with Product, QA, Frontend, and Mobile. Cross-functional communication is an essential part of the role. Partially offload the Tech Lead: own architectural and technical decisions, independently drive complex integrations, and influence the platform's technical direction. This is not an executor role. We need someone with strong expert opinions who can be relied upon for key technical decisions.

Key results (30-60-90):

30 days: First features shipped to production. Deep dive into the stack, architecture, and domain (blockchain, fintech). Clear understanding of core services and how they interact.

60 days: Independently drives a complex integration or a major feature. Participates in architectural code reviews. Brings first proposals for improvements.

90 days: Makes architectural decisions on their scope. Influences technical direction. Partially offloads the Tech Lead in decision-making. Participates in planning.

What we offer:
  • Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.
  • An engineering culture that encourages the adoption of modern tools and development practices, giving engineers real influence over technologies, workflows, and technical decisions.
  • Two career tracks — grow into Tech Lead or deepen your expertise as Staff/Principal IC. You choose the path.
  • Career progression and professional development in a forward-thinking fintech environment.
  • Competitive salary range based on individual performance review.
  • Transparent feedback and a culture that values ownership, open dialogue, and visible impact.
Recruitment Process

  1. Application. Submit your application and CV.

  2. Application Review. Our team reviews your experience and qualifications.

  3. HR Interview. An introductory conversation to discuss your professional background and expectations.

  4. Technical Interview. Assessment of your technical expertise, system design skills, and relevant experience.

  5. Team Lead Interview. A discussion focused on team fit, collaboration style, and alignment with engineering culture.

  6. Offer. Receiving the offer and details about the next steps.

jobs.excerpt: Hello!  We're Teya. Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe.
jobs.description:
Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for deployments, incident response, and on-call rotations)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize scalable infrastructure and deployment pipelines that support fast, secure, and reliable software delivery.

This role requires strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code. The DevOps Engineer will work closely with development and engineering teams to improve deployment reliability, automate operational workflows, strengthen security, and ensure high system availability across environments.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys solving infrastructure challenges, optimizing systems at scale, and building highly automated and resilient environments.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Configure networking, compute, storage, IAM, and cloud services to support scalability and security
    • Optimize infrastructure performance, availability, and cost efficiency

CI/CD & Deployment Automation

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
    • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows across environments
    • Improve deployment reliability and support zero-downtime deployment strategies
    • Partner with engineering teams to streamline release cycles and reduce bottlenecks

Containerization & Kubernetes

  • Manage Docker-based application environments and Kubernetes clusters
    • Deploy and maintain microservices-based architectures
    • Monitor cluster health, autoscaling, and workload performance
    • Improve container orchestration efficiency and infrastructure stability

Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response

  • Implement observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools
    • Configure centralized logging and alerting systems (ELK Stack, Splunk, CloudWatch, etc.)
    • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations when required
    • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and improve system resiliency post-incident

Security & Compliance

  • Apply cloud security best practices including IAM, least privilege access, and encryption standards
    • Support compliance initiatives related to SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or similar frameworks
    • Run vulnerability scans, patch systems proactively, and monitor infrastructure security posture
    • Ensure deployment pipelines and infrastructure configurations follow security standards

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, runbooks, and deployment workflows
    • Identify opportunities for automation, reliability improvements, and operational efficiency
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with developers, QA, and engineering leadership to improve DevOps processes

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Problem solver who thrives at the intersection of development and operations
    • Calm, methodical, and reliable during high-pressure incidents and outages
    • Passionate about automation, scalability, reliability, and system optimization
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across technical and non-technical teams
    • Ownership-driven with a proactive approach to preventing issues before they occur

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering
    • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
    • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
    • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
    • Familiarity with Linux systems administration and scripting
    • Experience with monitoring and logging platforms

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Expertise with Terraform, Pulumi, or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • Experience supporting SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise-scale applications
    • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
    • Experience optimizing infrastructure costs and cloud resource utilization
    • Cloud or DevOps certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, CKAD, or equivalent

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A DevOps Engineer’s day revolves around ensuring systems are automated, secure, scalable, and reliable. You will:

  • Review monitoring dashboards and investigate infrastructure alerts or incidents
    • Improve CI/CD pipelines to accelerate deployments and reduce failures
    • Provision or modify infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation
    • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot deployments and optimize application performance
    • Analyze logs and system metrics to identify reliability or scalability issues
    • Update runbooks, workflows, and infrastructure documentation
    • Implement automation improvements that reduce manual operational work

In essence: you are the backbone of infrastructure reliability and deployment automation, ensuring systems remain stable, scalable, and efficient while enabling engineering teams to ship faster with confidence.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Deployment frequency and release reliability improvements

• System uptime ≥ 99.9%

  • Reduced MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) for production incidents
    • Infrastructure cost optimization and efficiency improvements
    • Reduced deployment failures and rollback rates
    • Positive engineering feedback regarding deployment speed and reliability

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., design a CI/CD pipeline or provision infrastructure using Terraform)
    • Client Interview with Engineering / DevOps Leadership

• Offer & Background Verification

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview
